Title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Transformation Advisor), Independent Software Vendor (ISV)
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Canada is looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) team, a role at the intersection of technology strategy, business transformation, and customer partnership.  
  
You will own the success of a portfolio of Canadian ISVs navigating multi-year cloud, SaaS, and AI transformation journeys. Your job is to ensure these companies don't just adopt AWS; they build competitive advantage on it. That means helping them migrate critical workloads, accelerate AI and agentic capability adoption, and translate their technology investments into measurable business outcomes.  
  
In this role you are connecting ISV customers to the right AWS expertise, programs, and teams at the right time, and holding the thread across complex, multi-stakeholder environments.  
  
If you thrive where technical depth and business strategy intersect, and you want your work to have visible, lasting impact on how Canada's most innovative software companies grow, then this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Drive Customer Outcomes  

* Own the success of a portfolio of ISV accounts, working backwards from each customer's strategic milestones to define and execute a clear path to value realization
* Lead roadmap-to-outcome alignment sessions,
* Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live milestones that accelerate each customer's cloud and AI journey
* Help ISVs build the governance, operating models, and data infrastructure needed to sustain long-term transformation, not just hit short-term milestones
* Support customers in adopting generative AI and agentic capabilities that are reshaping how software is built, delivered, and monetized

  
Orchestrate Across AWS  

* Serve as the connective tissue between ISV customers and AWS teams (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, Professional Services, and Partner teams) ensuring coordinated, high-quality engagement
* Contribute to account planning, translating strategic goals into executable actions with clear ownership and timelines
* Identify and remove systemic barriers that slow customer progress, escalating with precision and urgency when needed

  
Lead Strategic Engagements  

* Lead director-level engagements, co-innovation workshops, and strategic planning sessions with Product, Engineering, and Technology leadership within ISV accounts
* Help translate complex AI and cloud solutions into business cases for senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical teams and executive decision-makers
* Support customers through critical decision points: workload migration sequencing, AI adoption strategy, SaaS architecture evolution

  
Manage with Rigor  

* Maintain structured cadence through reporting, tracking, and health monitoring across your portfolio
* Apply structured delivery mechanisms and measurement frameworks to ensure customers realize the value of their AWS investment
* Proactively identify risks (technical, organizational, or commercial) and drive mitigation plans before they become escalations

  
Raise the Bar Internally  

* Challenge conventional thinking and take initiative on customer challenges, bringing new ideas, tools, and mechanisms to problems
* Bring the best of AWS and Amazon to customers, proactively solving problems by connecting them to emerging capabilities, programs, and expertise they may not know exist
* Contribute to repeatable mechanisms and internal enablement, sharing learnings from your customer engagements to help raise the bar for how AWS delivers customer success in Canada.

  
About the team  
You don't need to build cloud infrastructure, but you need to understand it well enough to earn the trust of the engineers who do.  
  
On any given day, you might help a VP/Director of Product at a Canadian SaaS company understand the business case for migrating their core platform to AWS, facilitate an alignment session between an ISV's engineering team and AWS Solutions Architecture, or work with your internal team to unblock a stalled migration that's at risk of missing its go-live milestone.  
  
You'll be working with some of Canada's most innovative software companies at a pivotal moment, when AI is fundamentally changing how software is built, delivered, and monetized. If you thrive in environments where technical depth and clear communication are equally valued, this role is for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
* Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
* 5+ years of IT and/or Management Consulting experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Cloud Technology Certification, or AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. As a total compensation company, Amazon's package may include other elements such as sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, basic life & AD&D insurance), Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP), Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP), paid time off, and other resources to improve health and well-being. We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those interviewed will be advised as to hiring status.

Title: Customer Success Manager
Description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.
  
  
As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.
  
  
The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, renewal, and expansion.
* Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
* Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
* Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
* Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
* Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
* Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
* Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high-severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
* Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
* Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experienced professional with 8+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
* Exceptional English & Arabic communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
* Skills for analyzing technical concepts, translating them into business terms, and mapping business requirements into technical features.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
* Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies.
* Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate the resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.
* **Fluency in both Arabic and English is essential**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* +2 years in the Salesforce Ecosystem.
* Salesforce product certifications are a plus ( **Administrator** , Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, **Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant** ).
* Knowledge of Salesforce products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy.
* Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. demonstrated behaviors in previous jobs, that align to role needs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Title: Gestionnaire de Mandats | Engagement Manager, Services professionnels / Professional Services
Description:
**Description**
L'équipe des Services Professionnels d'Amazon Web Services (ProServe) recherche un Gestionnaire d'Engagement (EM) hautement qualifié et polyvalent pour rejoindre notre équipe et diriger la livraison de projets de solutions cloud complexes. Dans ce rôle, vous combinerez expertise technique et solides compétences en leadership de projet pour mener à bien des implémentations réussies de solutions basées sur AWS pour nos clients. Vous ferez le lien entre les exigences commerciales et les solutions techniques, facilitant les discussions techniques et assurant l'alignement avec les résultats attendus par les clients. En appliquant les cadres AWS tels que Well-Architected et Cloud Adoption Framework tout en démontrant une crédibilité technique auprès de diverses parties prenantes, vous traduirez les besoins des clients en exigences techniques claires, décomposerez des problèmes complexes et prendrez des décisions éclairées en tenant compte des compromis entre performance, évolutivité, sécurité et impact commercial.
  
  
Possédant une solide expérience en technologie et en gestion de programmes/projets, vous validerez les solutions techniques par rapport aux objectifs commerciaux, reconnaîtrez quand une évaluation technique supplémentaire est nécessaire et gérerez les risques techniques. On attendra de vous que vous obteniez et mainteniez les certifications AWS pertinentes, développiez une expertise spécifique à votre domaine et communiquiez efficacement les concepts techniques à des publics techniques et commerciaux. Au fur et à mesure de votre progression, vous dirigerez des projets techniques de plus en plus complexes, façonnerez des stratégies techniques inter-organisationnelles et établirez les meilleures pratiques dans votre domaine. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez vos capacités de gestion et de leadership pour exécuter avec succès les plans de projet, identifier et gérer proactivement les risques, résoudre les problèmes, escalader lorsque nécessaire et mener les projets à leur terme, tout en dépassant les attentes des clients.
  
  
L'organisation des Services Professionnels AWS est une équipe mondiale d'experts qui aident les clients à réaliser les résultats commerciaux souhaités lors de l'utilisation du Cloud AWS. Nous travaillons en collaboration avec les équipes des clients et le Réseau de Partenaires AWS (APN) pour exécuter des initiatives d'informatique en cloud d'entreprise. Notre équipe fournit une assistance à travers une collection d'offres qui aident les clients à atteindre des résultats spécifiques liés à l'adoption du cloud d'entreprise. Nous fournissons également des conseils ciblés à travers nos pratiques de spécialité mondiales, qui couvrent une variété de solutions, technologies et industries.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Engagement Manager (EM) to join our team and lead the delivery of complex cloud solution projects. In this role you will combine technical expertise with strong project leadership skills to drive successful implementations of AWS-based solutions for our clients. You will bridge business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating technical discussions and ensuring alignment with customer outcomes. Applying AWS frameworks like Well-Architected and Cloud Adoption Framework while demonstrating technical credibility across diverse stakeholders, you will distill customer needs into clear technical requirements, decompose complex problems, and make informed trade-off decisions considering performance, scalability, security, and business impact.
  
  
Possessing strong technology and program/project management experience, you will validate technical solutions against business goals, recognize when additional technical evaluation is needed, and manage technical risks. You will be expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, develop domain-specific expertise, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. As you progress, you’ll lead increasingly complex technical projects, shape cross-organizational technical strategies, and establish best practices in your domain. In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectation
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
En tant que gestionnaire de programme/projet technologique expérimenté, vous serez responsable de :
  
  

* Diriger et gérer des projets complexes de migration et d'implémentation cloud
* Exploiter une connaissance approfondie des services AWS, des architectures et des meilleures pratiques pour guider les décisions techniques et la planification stratégique
* Faire le lien entre les exigences commerciales et les solutions techniques, faciliter les discussions d'ingénierie et assurer l'alignement avec les résultats commerciaux des clients
* Traduire les besoins des clients en exigences techniques claires et les associer aux résultats commerciaux
* Décomposer des problèmes techniques complexes en solutions réalisables et livrables
* Contribuer à la documentation technique et définir des normes de documentation

As an experienced technology program/project manager, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading and managing complex cloud migration and implementation projects
* Leveraging comprehensive knowledge of AWS services, architectures, and best practices to guide technical decisions and strategic planning
* Bridging business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating engineering discussions and ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes
* Distilling customer needs into clear technical requirements and map them to business outcomes
* Decomposing complex technical problems into actionable, deliverable solutions
* Contributing to technical documentation and define documentation standards

**About The Team**
À propos d'AWS (English description to follow)
  
  
Des expériences diverses

Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les qualifications et compétences énumérées dans la description du poste, nous encourageons les candidats à postuler. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. Title: Infrastructure Construction Manager
Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Infrastructure Construction Manager** to lead and oversee all on-site execution activities for large-scale civil and utility infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will manage site teams, subcontractors, equipment, and daily operations to ensure works—such as earthworks, roads, drainage, and wet/dry utilities—are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in strict compliance with quality and regulatory standards.Key Responsibilities

* **Site Execution & Leadership:** Direct and coordinate daily site construction operations across multiple work fronts, managing site engineers, superintendents, foremen, and subcontractors.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering field.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 10–15 years of proven site management experience on major infrastructure projects (roads, highways, bridges, sewerage, stormwater, potable water, and power/telecom networks).
* **Certifications:** PMP, NEBOSH/IOSH, or relevant local engineering registration/society membership is preferred.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong ability to read and interpret complex civil/utility drawings, familiarity with Primavera P6/MS Project schedules, and solid knowledge of construction methodologies.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with local authority codes, utility standards, and traffic management/diversion protocols.
* **Core Competencies:** Decisive field leadership, strong conflict resolution, crisis management, and clear communication across technical and non-technical teams.

Title: Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring
Description:

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. ‎
  
  
The Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring owns the operational management and health of IMCO’s enterprise AI platforms, with a focus on observability, reliability, performance, usage and cost. **Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform Operations & Observability**

* Establish and manage enterprise observability and monitoring capabilities across Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Power Platform AI services, and future AI platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve monitoring and observability across AI platforms, models and agents, including performance, reliability, agent activity, usage and operational risks.
* Develop dashboards, alerts and KPIs that provide visibility into platform health, adoption, usage, capacity and cost.
* Identify and coordinate resolution of platform incidents and production issues, maintaining appropriate runbooks, support procedures and service expectations.

**Platform Management & Controls**

* Establish and maintain platform standards covering environments, connectors, capacity, solution management and enterprise use of Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Implement and operate platform controls and guardrails aligned with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Privacy and Technology Risk requirements.
* Maintain appropriate access, environment and platform management practices to support secure and scalable use.
* Partner with Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data Governance and AI Governance to ensure the platforms remain aligned with enterprise standards.

**Solution Lifecycle and Operational Readiness**

* Establish lifecycle and operational practices for AI and Power Platform solutions, including development, testing, deployment, release and production support.
* Maintain appropriate ALM, source control and deployment practices, including Azure DevOps integration where applicable.
* Lead operational-readiness assessments for solutions entering production, ensuring monitoring, support, recovery and ownership are in place.
* Manage platform releases, upgrades and changes and support the transition of new solutions into ongoing operations.

**Service Management & Operational Insights**

* Maintain visibility into AI consumption, licensing, platform capacity, costs, reliability and operational effectiveness.
* Provide management reporting and operational insights to support technology, governance and risk decisions.
* Manage operational relationships and service escalations with Microsoft and other relevant platform vendors.
* Evaluate emerging platform-management and observability capabilities that can improve the reliability and operation of IMCO’s AI environment.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise platform operations, cloud services, application operations or digital workplace technologies.
* Strong experience with the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform and enterprise cloud services.
* Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, enterprise AI platforms, conversational AI or agent-based solutions.
* Demonstrated experience with monitoring, observability, telemetry, incident management and operational reporting for enterprise platforms or applications.
* Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), DevOps, release management and production support practices.
* Experience establishing and operating platform controls, environment management, support models and operational standards.
* Strong understanding of service health, reliability, capacity, usage and cost management for cloud-based platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Risk and business teams.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.

* Leads system integration planning, release management, and planning for demonstrations, proof of concepts and pilots.
* Leads creating cross functional workstreams and driving execution for sales enablement, development and deployment.
* Independently builds relationships and working across all relevant areas of the solution business including Sales, Services, IT, Finance, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Support.
* Organizes and presents business, technical and program reviews/status to Senior Leadership using digital media and dashboards.
* Recognized as an "expert" in the business function and processes in which the program is operating.
* Motivates teams to ensure solutions are reliable and of quality, in a highly collaborative fashion.
* Independently coordinates deliverables and project assets to assist the project team.
* Personally anticipates and addresses obstacles or issues that are moderate to significant in severity and escalates complex issues to management for assistance. Independently engages additional resources as needed to address obstacles or delays.

* Demonstrates advanced understanding of development processes and product launch scope and activities
* Demonstrates strength in hiring, recruiting, managing, developing, coaching, and retaining individuals and teams.

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or STEM degree required
* Minimum 12 years' Engineering/Technical Program management and Scrum Master experience for products in fast paced environment, including minimum 2 years as team supervisor / manager.
* Must have experience with small form factored hardware product development for consumer or enterprise customers (such as wearable computers, barcode ring scanners, Headphones, IoT devices etc.)
* Must have experience and past responsibility for multiple significant solution offerings delivered-to-market for AI and/or SaaS based offerings.
* Must be enterprise Technical Program Manager and have experience in professional services (external client facing)
* Must have demonstrated experience working in a PMO

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experienced in Solution development made up of firmware, BSP, Applications/utilities for Android and iOS, cloud development, software/services integration.

* Demonstrates the ability to see cross-functional impacts of decisions and project plans and execution.
* Expert in end-to-end plan development for NPI including marketing, launch planning, supply chain/manufacturing, post sell support/repair services etc.
* Experience in contract/SOW management, strategic supplier relationship management to ensure business continuity and alignment
* Experienced in managing a budget of up to $15M for business unit, demonstrated financial acumen with experience in annual budget creation, quarterly forecasting, and management of accruals and invoicing
* Experienced in industry standard Program/solution lifecycle management processes and ISO compliance
* Demonstrated experience in architecting and executing digital transformation initiatives by leveraging AI, automation, and data analytics to drive process efficiencies, solve complex business problems, and deliver measurable value

* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Solid critical thinking and questioning skills

* Ability to drive definition and creation of solutions from skeleton use cases

* Advanced expertise with software development best practices including Scaled Agile, TDD and Continuous Integration; a track record of applying these methodologies

Title: Senior Security Manager, Assistance
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic **Senior Security Manager, Assistance** to lead our regional Security Assistance team, based in Dubai.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the delivery of frontline security assistance services across Mashreq, Iran, East and Southern Africa. The successful candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership, ensuring the delivery of high-quality security advice, case management, incident response, crisis support and preventative security services to our clients and members.

Working closely with the Global Security Director, Assistance, Regional Operations Directors and wider global security network, you will drive operational excellence, strengthen regional capabilities and ensure consistent service delivery in line with International SOS standards and client expectations.

You will also play an important role in developing regional security talent, supporting business growth, strengthening client relationships and maintaining operational readiness in an evolving security environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Management and Leadership**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Security Managers, Security Specialists and associated security personnel across the region.
* Lead, coach and develop regional security teams, promoting professional growth, engagement and high performance.
* Oversee performance management, objective setting, succession planning and workforce development.
* Ensure effective resource planning and allocation to meet operational demands and client requirements.
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, operational excellence and customer focus.
* Lead the Security Case Lead function in coordination with Security Managers.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training and retention of regional security personnel.
* Act as deputy to the Global Security Director, Assistance, in the Middle East region.

**Core Client & Internal Support:**

* Oversee the delivery of regional security assistance services, ensuring timely, effective and customer-focused outcomes.
* Provide expert security guidance and support to clients, travellers, expatriates and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain oversight of security case management and ensure consistent service quality and operational standards.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex security cases, incidents and operational challenges.
* Coordinate security responses to emergencies, critical incidents and crisis situations.
* Monitor regional security developments and ensure operational responses reflect current threat assessments and intelligence.
* Provide senior-level review and quality assurance of security advice, assessments and recommendations.
* Maintain regional operational preparedness plans, procedures and response protocols.
* Oversee regional security provider networks, partnerships and the Secure Hotel Programme.
* Support Incident Management Teams and Crisis Management Teams during major incidents and events.
* Promote effective collaboration across Medical, Operations, Travel, Aviation, Network Services and Intelligence & Analysis teams.

**Consulting Delivery & Sales, Marketing Support**

* Deliver high-quality security consulting services in line with client requirements.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of security risk assessments, country assessments, travel security programmes and tailored client solutions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, workshops and business development engagements.
* Deliver security briefings, webinars, training programmes and awareness sessions.
* Support the preparation of proposals, tenders and commercial opportunities.
* Contribute to client retention through expert advice and excellent service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to enhance existing services and develop new client value propositions.
* Represent International SOS at relevant industry events, conferences and stakeholder meetings.
* Support regional commercial objectives through security expertise and operational insight

**Required Experience & Skills**
--------------------------------

* At least 8 years of experience in security operations and planning, including operational deployment in hostile and/or challenging environments.
* Experience gained within private security companies, military, NGOs, government or relevant private-sector organisations, ideally within the Middle East.
* Proven experience in leading and managing security teams, including remote or hybrid teams.
* Strong experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Extensive knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse risk environments.
* Strong understanding of the political, security and threat landscape across the Middle East and wider region.
* Experience in conducting security risk assessments and developing practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Ability to analyse complex security, logistical and threat-related information and translate findings into clear recommendations and action plans.
* Experience preparing reports and providing advice to senior management and decision-makers.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
* Strong IT proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.

**Desirable Experience**

* Crisis management and emergency response experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery.
* Client-facing presentations, public speaking and media engagement.
* Business development and commercial support.
* Quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications & Education**
------------------------------

* Degree-level education in Security Studies, Conflict Studies, International Politics, International Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience.
* Accreditation or membership with a recognised regional security or risk management professional body is desirable.

**Languages**
-------------

* Excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Arabic, French or another European language would be an advantage.

**Why Join International SOS?**
-------------------------------

Join a global organisation where your expertise can make a meaningful difference in protecting people and supporting organisations operating in complex environments.

At International SOS, you will work alongside experienced professionals across a global network, contribute to critical security operations and help deliver services that protect the health, safety and security of people worldwide.

**If you are an experienced security leader looking for an opportunity to make an impact on a regional and global scale, we would like to hear from you.**

Title: Vice President - Technology Commercials and Delivery
Description:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.

Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure & entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing & logistics, and science.

**For the Good of Tomorrow**

Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
**Vice President – Technology Commercials & Delivery**
at Dubai Holding. The role holder is responsible for the commercial performance and delivery reliability of Dubai Holding Group IT. The role owns the Group IT sourcing strategy, vendor and contract commercials, and the Group IT delivery model, ensuring that every service, programme and supplier relationship delivers measurable value for its cost.

The role puts Group IT's “How We Operate” principles into practice: explicit ownership, deliberate sourcing choices, realistic delivery commitments through Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), and supplier management that connects service performance with commercial value. It manages the end-to-end commercial lifecycle – from sourcing strategy and negotiation through contract performance, renewal and exit – and the delivery governance that turns approved demand into on-time, on-budget outcomes.

The role acts as the Group CTO's lead for commercials and delivery, partnering with Group Procurement, Group Finance, Legal, Strategy & Value Creation and the Verticals to reduce cost-to-serve, remove duplication across contracts, and ensure Group IT commits only to what it can deliver.

**Key Accountabilities:**

**Commercial Strategy & Sourcing**

* Define and own the Group IT commercial and sourcing strategy, aligned to Group CTO priorities and Dubai Holding procurement policy
* Make deliberate retain, partner, automate or buy decisions for each service area, based on operational criticality, control requirements, cost, flexibility and knowledge retention
* Consolidate demand across Central IT and the Verticals to use Group-wide buying power and remove duplicate contracts
* Lead category strategies for software, cloud, infrastructure, telecoms, professional services and managed services

**Vendor Negotiation & Contract Management**

* Lead commercial negotiations for strategic technology agreements, including enterprise licensing, cloud commitments, multi-year and outcome-based contracts
* Own the contract portfolio lifecycle: renewals calendar, true-ups, price reviews, benchmarking and exit planning
* Ensure contracts include clear SLAs, KPIs, service credits, termination rights, IP and data protection terms, in partnership with Legal and Procurement
* Review contract terms, consumption and duplication to identify renegotiation, consolidation and termination opportunities

**Supplier Performance & Value Realisation**

* Establish a tiered supplier management framework with regular business reviews for strategic suppliers
* Connect supplier service performance with commercial value, tracking SLA compliance, service credits, penalties and delivered outcomes
* Track savings and cost avoidance, validated with IT Finance
* Manage supplier risk, including concentration, financial stability and third-party cyber risk, with Information Security and IT GRC

**Delivery Model & Portfolio Execution**

* Own the Group IT delivery model, ensuring programmes and projects are delivered on time, on budget and to agreed scope
* Run delivery planning through SPM, using effort estimates and capacity checks so that commitments are realistic
* Set common delivery discipline for ownership, progress, risk and commitments, while allowing teams to use suitable execution methods (agile, waterfall or hybrid)
* Drive transparent reprioritisation when capacity or demand changes materially, escalating trade-offs to the Group CTO

**Partner & System Integrator Delivery Oversight**

* Oversee delivery by system integrators and managed service partners, with clear internal accountability and effective interfaces
* Define statements of work, acceptance criteria, milestone payments and change control that protect Dubai Holding's commercial position
* Intervene early on underperforming engagements and apply commercial levers where needed
* Ensure knowledge transfer and avoid unhealthy dependency on any single partner

**Commercial & Financial Governance**

* Ensure all sourcing and contracting complies with Dubai Holding procurement policy, Delegation of Authority (DOA) and audit requirements
* Partner with IT Finance on budgets, commitments, accruals and the commercial basis for chargeback to the Verticals
* Maintain a complete, auditable record of contracts, approvals and commercial decisions, and support Internal Audit and external audit reviews
* Build business cases with clear total cost of ownership (TCO), ROI and payback for major sourcing decisions

**Deliver Agentic AI Capabilities**

* Manage delivery of strategic group-level AI agentic projects and initiatives
* Support and deliver vertical-level implementations of strategic AI platforms
* Deliver business transformation projects to meet group-level value creation and efficiency objectives

**AI-Enabled Commercial & Delivery Operations**

* Evaluate and negotiate agentic AI and automation platforms, including consumption- and credit-based pricing models
* Apply AI and analytics to contract intelligence, spend analytics, renewal risk and delivery forecasting
* Apply “Right Work, Right Owner” in sourcing decisions, moving repetitive work to automation where it creates value
* Ensure AI vendor contracts address data ownership, model use, IP, responsible use and exit terms

**Leadership, Stakeholder Management & Reporting**

* Build and lead a high-performing commercial, vendor management and delivery team
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Group CTO and Group IT leadership on commercial and delivery matters
* Provide executive reporting on the contract portfolio, supplier performance, savings and delivery status for leadership forums, steering committees and quarterly business reviews
* Build strong working relationships with Procurement, Finance, Legal and Vertical leadership

**What we’re looking for:**

* 15+ years in technology commercial management, sourcing, vendor management and/or IT delivery in large, complex organisations
* 8+ years in senior leadership roles leading commercial and delivery teams
* Proven record of negotiating high-value technology contracts and delivering measurable, validated savings
* Experience leading portfolio and programme delivery at scale, including oversight of system integrators and managed service partners
* Experience in complex, multi-entity organisations (real estate, hospitality, investment or similar sectors preferred); GCC/UAE experience preferred

**Education/Professional Certification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Finance or a related field
* MBA or relevant Master's degree strongly preferred
* CIPS or IAOP (COP) certification preferred
* PMP / MSP / PRINCE2, ITIL v4 or SAFe certifications
* FinOps Certified Practitioner is an advantage

**Technical Competencies:**

* Strong analytical thinking and commercial judgement
* Deep knowledge of technology commercial models: enterprise licensing, SaaS, cloud consumption, outcome-based and managed services
* Contract fundamentals, negotiation strategy and commercial risk management
* Vendor and third-party risk management frameworks
* Portfolio and programme management, including SPM tools (e.g., ServiceNow SPM or equivalent)
* Financial acumen: TCO, ROI, CapEx/OpEx, budgeting and forecasting
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion procurement and contract processes
* Data-driven reporting and dashboards (e.g., Power BI)
* Understanding of AI and agentic platform pricing and commercial structures

**Behavioural Competencies:**

* Strong executive presence and influence at C-suite level
* Tough, fair negotiator who protects Dubai Holding's interests while building long-term partnerships
* Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline
* Clear, direct communicator who makes trade-offs and commitments explicit
* Results-oriented with high personal accountability and integrity
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams

**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.**

Title: Digital Platforms Manager
Description:
Beond is a Maldivian premium leisure airline. Our operations are based in the Maldives, and our management and support functions are headquartered in Dubai. We are looking for a **Digital Platforms Manager** to own flybeond.com, our mobile site and our iOS app, together with the booking, payment and partner systems behind them. This role is based in our Dubai office.

**What you will do**

* Own the technical roadmap for flybeond.com, the mobile site and the iOS app, working closely with Commercial, Marketing and IT
* Manage day to day CMS operations in Contentful, including news, homepage banners, route pages and multilingual content (English, Arabic, German)
* Own the relationship with our Internet Booking Engine (IBE) vendor, coordinating feature delivery, bug fixes and releases
* Manage payment gateway integrations, keeping us PCI DSS compliant and coordinating releases with payment providers
* Oversee our Passenger Service System (Zenith) and routes and schedules data, including schedule updates and new routes
* Handle SSL certificate renewals and DNS management across our web domains
* Manage third party integrations, including holiday packages, metasearch, ticketing partners and GDS and interline connectivity
* Evaluate and introduce AI and analytics tools that improve the guest experience and commercial performance
* Hold vendors to their SLAs, timelines and quality standards
* Support and brief the content team on CMS workflows, locale settings and publishing
* Work in an Agile way: run sprint planning, manage backlogs and coordinate engineering, product and commercial teams
* Drive personalisation and A/B testing to improve conversion and guest engagement

  
**Requirements**

**Essential**

* 4+ years in an ecommerce, digital technology or product management role, ideally in aviation, travel or hospitality
* Hands on experience running a modern headless or composable CMS (Contentful strongly preferred)
* Experience owning an Internet Booking Engine or a similar transactional web platform
* Experience with payment gateway integrations, PCI DSS and release coordination with payment providers
* Working knowledge of DNS, SSL certificates and cloud infrastructure (Azure or equivalent)
* Comfortable with APIs, webhooks and integrations between third party systems (PSS, GDS, metasearch, holiday packages)
* Strong vendor management; able to hold development partners and agencies to SLAs
* Clear written and spoken English, and able to brief technical and non technical colleagues
* Experience of Agile/Scrum teams: sprint planning, backlog grooming and cross functional working

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Zenith, Radixx or another airline PSS
* SOAP/XML integrations and IATA standards
* Next.js, Node.js or MongoDB
* Multilingual content, including right to left languages
* Personalisation, A/B testing and analytics tools (GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar), and AI in customer experience
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Technology or a related field

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive tax free salary and package
* The chance to shape the digital experience of a premium leisure airline

**Disclaimer:**

If you do not hear from us within 4 weeks of applying, please consider your application unsuccessful on this occasion. We receive a high volume of applications and are unable to reply to everyone.

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Portfolio Governance
Description:
Join our Global Technology & Cyber Security (GTCS) team!

  
  

The Senior Manager, Technology Portfolio Governance helps Global Architecture & Engineering turn portfolio priorities into focused, measurable execution. Working across senior leadership and technology teams, you will provide the governance, insights, and portfolio discipline needed to support informed decisions about priorities, capacity, investment, risk, and delivery.

  
  

In this role, you will bring together data, perspectives, and competing priorities to help leaders understand trade-offs, make timely decisions, and follow through on commitments. You will also help modernize how portfolio governance works by improving processes, analytics, workflows, and automation, increasing transparency while reducing unnecessary administrative effort.

  
  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  
  

**Portfolio Strategy & Planning**

* Coordinate portfolio intake, prioritization, capacity planning, dependencies, risks, and commitments across Global Architecture & Engineering.
* Provide leaders with a clear, integrated view of portfolio priorities, performance, risks, dependencies, and overall health.
* Enable portfolio planning and rebalancing by identifying capacity constraints, competing priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Partner with portfolio and delivery teams to strengthen data quality and ensure portfolio information supports timely, informed decisions.
  

  

**Governance & Executive Decision Support**

* Lead and continuously improve portfolio governance practices across Global Architecture & Engineering.
* Establish clear governance routines, decision points, ownership, and accountability across portfolio activities.
* Coordinate portfolio governance across leadership teams and business areas while maintaining clear ownership with the teams responsible for delivery.
* Translate complex portfolio information into concise insights, recommendations, and decision points for senior leaders.
* Surface material risks, capacity constraints, dependencies, and trade-offs requiring leadership attention.
* Enable follow-through on leadership decisions by clarifying ownership, actions, commitments, and escalation paths.
  

  

**Portfolio Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner across Architecture, Engineering, Finance, Risk, and other functions to strengthen portfolio planning and governance practices.
* Improve portfolio processes, reporting, tools, and workflows to increase transparency while reducing unnecessary administrative effort.
* Promote consistent portfolio standards and ways of working across Global Architecture & Engineering.
* Identify opportunities to use automation, analytics, and technology to improve portfolio monitoring, reporting, governance, and follow-through.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Typically 7+ years of relevant experience in portfolio management, governance, strategy execution, transformation, technology management, or related work within complex or matrixed organizations.
* Experience with portfolio planning and prioritization, including capacity, dependencies, risks, commitments, and investment or financial considerations.
* Experience establishing or operating governance practices across multiple teams or business areas.
* Ability to analyze complex portfolio information, identify meaningful trends and trade-offs, and translate findings into clear insights and recommended actions.
* Ability to build alignment, accountability, and momentum across teams and stakeholders without relying on direct reporting relationships.
* Experience engaging senior leaders, facilitating discussions, and helping stakeholders navigate competing priorities and decisions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt complex information for executive and working-level audiences.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting enterprise technology portfolios, large-scale transformations, or technology functions such as Architecture, Engineering, Cloud, Infrastructure, or Cybersecurity.
* Experience with Jira or other portfolio management, reporting, analytics, or visualization platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile, product, project, and portfolio management practices.
* Experience improving portfolio operations through automation, analytics, or workflow optimization.

* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

Title: Oracle Test Manager – Program Manager
Description:
Our client is a leading global technology and IT services organization, providing innovative solutions across digital transformation, IT consulting, engineering, and business process services. With a strong international presence, the company partners with businesses across various industries to deliver technology-driven solutions
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Test Manager to oversee and enhance our testing processes within a dynamic program management environment. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing test strategies, ensuring quality assurance across multiple projects, and leading a team of testers to deliver high-quality software products.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Test Manager Oracle transformation program covering Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, HCM, Retail, airport operations, and related integrations.
* Test Manager Oracle-wide Oracle transformation program covering Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, HCM, Retail, airport operations, and related integrations.
* The Test Manager will act as the program's central testing SPOC and lead the end-to-end testing lifecycle across multiple releases and workstreams.

Key responsibilities will include:
  
  
Establishing and governing integrated test plans across SIT, UAT, regression, performance, security, operational acceptance, payroll reconciliation, and Oracle quarterly release testing.
  
  
Coordinating business, IT, implementation-partner, internal application, and third-party integration teams.
  
  
Managing test readiness, environments, data, test scripts, requirements traceability, execution, defect triage, entry/exit criteria, evidence, reporting, quality gates, and phase signoffs.
  
  
Driving risk-based testing, business-critical end-to-end scenarios, test automation, metrics, executive reporting, and release-readiness decisions.
  
  
Ensuring consistent testing governance across Oracle Cloud applications, custom solutions, interfaces, reports, and integrated systems.
  
  
The preferred candidate should have strong experience managing testing for large, complex Oracle Cloud implementation programs, ideally covering Oracle Fusion ERP, HCM, Procurement, SCM, Payroll, EPM, Retail, WMS/OTM, OIC/PaaS integrations, and third-party applications.
  
  
Experience with enterprise test-management tools, Tricentis Tosca or comparable automation platforms, senior stakeholder management, and multi-vendor delivery is highly desirable.
  
  
Oracle guidance similarly emphasizes cross-functional implementation leadership and liaison across the customer, implementation partner, support, and engineering teams, while its testing methodology highlights risk-based coverage, early defect detection, requirements traceability, and disciplined test governance.
  
  
Qualifications:
  
  
Bachelors degree in IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 10+ years of IT delivery experience, including 5+ years with Oracle Maintenance Cloud. Experience with Oracle SCM, OIC, APIs, enterprise integrations, analytics, and reporting solutions.
  
  

* Proven experience in a Test Manager or similar role, with a strong understanding of software testing methodologies and tools.
* Experience in program management and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with diverse teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on delivering quality results.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience in implementing Agile testing practices is a plus.

Title: Manager, Field Services Operations
Description:
PowerON Energy Solutions
  
  
Full-time
  
  
In-Office | Toronto, ON, Canada
  
  
This posting is for a newly created position
  
  
Salary range $120,000 - 140,000
  
  
PowerON delivers comprehensive electrification solutions, including infrastructure development and operations and maintenance (O&M). The Manager, Field Services Operations is a frontline operational owner responsible for ensuring that all preventive and corrective maintenance activities across PowerON's assets, including DC fast charging infrastructure, electrical distribution and protection equipment, Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), communications/SCADA platforms, and balance-of-plant infrastructure, are performed properly, safely, and to the required technical standard, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. This role directs PowerON's technician workforce across all shifts and all associated sub-contractors, including final decision and resource allocation for field based priorities.
  
  
The Manager is the single point of accountability for dispatch, technical execution, quality, safety and environmental compliance, supporting strategic customer relationships and ensuring exceptional service delivery across our portfolio. Working closely with our O&M, projects and 24/7 monitoring teams, this role reports to the Senior Manager, Asset Management & Operations, escalating complex, high impact or systemic issues while independently owning the day to day execution of field maintenance operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Leadership and Team Development**

* Lead and develop a team of field based technicians and sub-contractor specialists locally and nationally as the business grows, with an emphasis on self performing whenever possible
* Establish performance expectations and accountability measures aligned with the company objectives
* Coach, mentor and develop employees to support career growth and succession planning, managing performance and aligning with both HR policies and company objectives
* Manage recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews and employee engagement initiatives
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, safety and continuous improvement
* Manage within existing or new Collective Agreements where relevant to unionized employees

**Service Operations Management**

* Manage day to day field services locally and across our wider Canada portfolio for in house field technicians and sub-contractors over 24/7 operations, dealing with emergencies safely and promptly should they arise, including outside of normal business hours
* Exercise the final, independent managerial decision making authority over field operational priorities, technician and contractor assignments, remaining fully accountable through to completion of the task, project or activity
* Review Planned Maintenance schedules and tasking annually or more frequently as needed, updating to reflect equipment changes, historical trends, countermeasures from safety incidents, root cause analysis, industry best practice and OEM recommendations
* Ensure timely and effective support of customer installations with respect to planned maintenance, troubleshooting, corrective maintenance and emergency mobilization and response
* Ensure fulsome and accurate client and PowerON internal team communication in relation to unexpected failures, emergencies and subsequent safe return to normal operation
* Establish and maintain inventory control processes for spare parts across all client portfolios, including stocking strategy, purchasing approval, periodic audits and reconciliation, ensuring availability of critical spares and cost-effective use of inventory without compromising quality or reliability. Ensure resources, materials and equipment are available ahead of planned work, manage warranty claims/disputes and spare parts planning with vendors and OEM partners
* Drive service efficiency through effective resource scheduling, allocation, workload balancing and capacity planning
* Develop operational strategies to improve response times and customer satisfaction
* Monitor and report on service metrics, resource utilization, productivity and performance trends including but not limited to equipment availability, uptime, MTTR, MTBF

**Customer and Contractor Engagement**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs, sub-contractors, technical consultants and end users
* Act as the initial escalation point for critical customer impacting and technical issues
* Support strategic accounts through proactive service planning and relationship management while still maintaining suitable focus on less strategic client accounts and service delivery
* Collaborate with bid team to identify service growth and strengthen customer partnerships, contribute to new business proposals from O&M perspective

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide leadership and guidance on charging systems, DERS, electrical infrastructure and all equipment associated with client electrification systems
* Support field team with complex technical troubleshooting and problem resolution, ensuring adequate support and resources are available whenever required across a 24/7 operation
* Conduct root cause analysis and other appropriate investigations through to conclusion and implementation of approved countermeasures, updating all stakeholders throughout the process ensuring accurate and timely communication
* Ensure consistent adherence to associated technical standards, OEM recommendations and industry best practice

**Financial and Business Management**

* Manage departmental budget from planning through to execution
* Conduct regular financial analysis to identify efficiency improvements, gaps and forecast to adjust or recover as appropriate
* Monitor service revenues, costs and profitability
* Identify opportunities to expand service offerings and increase customer value
* Review resources on a continual basis to ensure efficiency and forecast future growth and demand
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of team timesheets, expenses and purchase card documentation, reviewing and approving with accuracy within the required payroll timeframes, avoiding errors to ensure correct payment and financial compliance
* Develop scope and draft agreements for third party sub-contractors for internal review prior to approval and sign off

**Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality Compliance**

* Maintain continual oversight of team safety performance, ensuring legislative compliance and PowerON and client policies are followed at all times promoting a strong safety conscious culture and achieving a zero-harm environment
* Serve as the final point of accountability for the safe and compliant execution of all preventive and corrective maintenance activities, including lock-out/tag-out, energized work controls and applicable codes and regulations
* Develop and lead safety initiatives including internal audits, deliver in house safety training in the form of ToolBox Talks and other available materials and media
* Fully investigate and document all issues utilizing PowerON’s Health, Safety and Environmental reporting platform, implementing root cause analysis and gaining approval for appropriate countermeasures from all stakeholders
* Develop and maintain a register of all licensing and certification requirements in relation to field technician and associated team member training, sub-contractor conformance. Plan and oversee training for internal and external requirements and build and maintain a technical library of SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and statements of work appropriate for PowerON’s O&M business

**Qualifications**

* Technical diploma or degree in electrical engineering, electromechanical, or a related discipline or equivalent field operations experience including critical infrastructure and systems
* Minimum of 5 years experience directly managing technical service related mobile and static teams both unionized and non unionized, prioritizing field based dispatch
* Strong working knowledge of good Health, Safety and Environmental practices aligning with ISO45001 and ISO14001 and including but not limited to practical applications of emergency response, spill management and lock-out/tag-out procedures across low/medium/high voltage systems
* Demonstrated knowledge of DC fast charging or similar electrification infrastructure, including electrical distribution, switchgear, power conversion equipment, and SCADA/communications platforms, or a strong ability to quickly build this expertise
* Working knowledge of DERs including emergency generators, BESS and solar systems
* Experience managing sub-contractors and OEM/vendor relationships, including statements of work, contract performance, warranty claims and spare parts control
* Experience with CMMS/EAM platforms (e.g. MaintainX or equivalent) for work planning, scheduling, dispatch, and work order control
* Awareness of ISO55000 in relation to asset management and the practical application in a field based environment
* Financial management experience in planning and operating budgets including labour, external partner costs, spare parts inventory, emergency response and future growth forecasting
* Project management and commissioning experience desirable
* Strong client-facing communication skills, with experience managing stakeholder updates and service review meetings
* Willingness to be available across shifts, including evenings, weekends, and on-call rotations, as required by a 24/7 operating environment
* Strong organizational and documentation skills, with the adaptability to take on new or evolving responsibilities as the role and business grow
* Flexibility to travel occasionally outside of the Toronto/GTA and Ontario, across Canada for the management of third party service providers and client relationships
* Hold valid driver’s license and be able to use own vehicle where appropriate to navigate around local sites

Title: IT Project Manager
Description:

With over 400 skilled engineers, we serve 100+ enterprise customers across 14 countries. Specialized in a wide array of premium services including Business Automation, Industrial Digitization, Low code Development, Cloud Services, Warehouse Automation & Strategic Outsourcing.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6-8 years of experience in IT Project Management.
* Proven experience delivering Identity & Access Management (IAM) or Cybersecurity projects.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, frameworks, and governance practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.

You'll lead the regional team of Onboarding Project Managers and Mid-Market Coaches who take these customers from signed contract through kickoff, go-live, Hypercare, and a clean handoff to Account Management.

Our mid-market customers expect a partner who understands their operation, not just our software. You'll set that standard: consultative kickoffs, clear expectations, and guidance on how their workflows and SOPs should change, not only which buttons to click.

You'll report to the Global Director of Mid-Market Onboarding and work alongside regional leads in LATAM, EMEA, and APAC. You'll be measured on time-to-live, deployment quality, onboarding CSAT, early-lifecycle retention, and the strength and readiness of your team.

* Take on the day-to-day leadership load (team questions, case investigations, call coverage) so the team keeps moving and senior leadership can focus on strategy
* Use AI and automation to cut administrative work for yourself and your team

Title: Project Manager - Program Management (St Louis)
Description:
**Description**

Burns & McDonnell is proud to be the market leader in providing program management services to the electric utility industry. As our clients focus on their capital investment in the energy delivery market, Burns & McDonnell brings a seasoned team to assist them across a variety of operational roles to ensure the needed grid improvements are executed on time and on budget. The ideal candidate will have a safety-first mindset, be dedicated to making their clients and teams successful, and take an entrepreneurial approach to their job. As programs are an extension of our clients day-to-day operations, roles within the program management track allow for frequent, often daily, client interaction. Engineers on the program management track leverage their technical expertise and education to make informed decisions in the execution of projects on behalf of our clients.

Project managers at Burns & McDonnell are a key part of our informal leadership structure. They will be expected to mentor junior staff and lead multi-disciplinary teams in the execution of our most complex projects. In the program management organization, project managers will be relied on to support the overall development of project management capabilities through the functional leadership of day-to-day task execution. Project managers may lead specific functional areas within a larger program or lead the entirety of a smaller program working directly with our clients to provide a premier client experience.

Generally, project managers in program management will pursue job responsibilities in the following areas:

**Project Management**

* Lead a cross-functional team to execute substation, transmission line, and telecommunication projects from inception through design and construction to closeout.
* Oversee 5-20 projects concurrently of varying sizes ($100k-$50M ) and voltages (4kV-765kV).
* Manage projects for schedule adherence identifying risks and requirements to successfully achieve a project’s in-service date.
* Navigate projects through client gate approval processes including presentations to senior and executive management as required by each client.
* Manage projects for financial adherence maintaining an accurate cost forecast reflecting committed and uncommitted costs for an estimate-at-completion.
* Coordinate craft labor resources with client approved vendors for construction, testing and other field activities.
* Provide regular status updates on projects by maintaining project data and routine reporting as well as meeting updates for clients.
* Lead project meetings with cost, schedule, real estate, environmental, construction and engineering resources to facilitate project execution.

**Portfolio Management**

* Develop a multi-year capital expenditure plan to support client’s replacement and betterment of electric transmission and distribution assets.
* Regular interface and coordination with project sponsor organizations to determine details of proposed plans and business justification.
* Ensure synergies across projects are incorporated into the portfolio of work to prevent scope from being duplicated or performed inefficiently.
* Monitor composition of client’s capital investment allocation to align with stated subsidiary investment targets for optimal rate of return.
* Engage with project sponsors to evaluate need-by date for realistic schedules and budgets.
* Assist with creation and compilation of rate filing support for federal and state filings.
* Review tabletop engineering estimates for accuracy and scope.
* Review project change requests (scope, In-service date, etc.) and reconcile with the existing and long-range portfolio of work.
* Interface with client’s accounting group to establish financial setup for projects.
* Create analyses & reports to assist the client in tracking, coordination, and execution of projects.
* Build baseline scopes, schedules, and budgets to be released to multiple client’s stakeholders.

**Outage/Construction Sequencing**

* Responsible for development of substation and transmission project construction lifecycles with focus on outage efficiency and constructability.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting specified deliverable dates and expectations.
* Analyze scoping and project documents to determine boundaries of required construction within substation and within electric grid.
* Conduct site walkdowns and project calls with project team as necessary to establish an achievable construction sequence with attainable outages.
* Analyze needed outages against adjacent outages scheduled in the area.
* Create initial outage sequence to communicate proposed construction lifecycle to project team.
* Coordinate with drafting resources to create engineering-caliber drawings that document the evolution of a project from present conditions to final state, and all needed incremental steps.
* As part of the Burns & McDonnell team we are looking for team members that foster a culture based on our MacCulture Principles, quality, diversity, and inclusion to enhance team cohesion and camaraderie. Individuals who want to tackle new and novel challenges within the utility industry to help our clients improve the execution of capital investment work can find entrepreneurial opportunities to assist in the pursuit and expansion of our program management offerings.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor Degree in engineering, construction management or related degree from accredited program required.
* Minimum of seven years of experience in engineering design, project management or a relevant role required.
* Completion of P.E., PMP, MBA or comparable advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thoughtfully and positively influence, lead and manage.
* Strong planning and analytical skills.
* E.I.T. or PE license strongly preferred.
* Must demonstrate superb oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to clearly and effectively present complex information to all levels of employees, management, and clients.
* Demonstrated success in project management which includes proposal development, contract negotiations, project planning, team leadership, budgeting, schedule management, and client coordination.
* Proven ability to develop business and establish relationships with clients.
* Travel 15-25% depending on project assignment and client needs.

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

We are seeking an experienced Head of IT to lead our global IT function within MultiBank Group. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with accountability for infrastructure, cloud, networks, corporate systems, AI applications, IT service management, business continuity and IT audits across all our offices worldwide.

You will lead the Support, Network and Systems Engineering teams and the Jira team, drive IT projects from start to finish, and build the IT foundation for every new office we open. The ideal candidate is technically strong, structured, security-minded and comfortable leading people in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**IT Leadership & Engineering Teams**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Support Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering and Jira teams.
* Oversee systems used by the engineering organisation and ensure Jira supports delivery teams effectively.
* Define the IT roadmap and align it with business and regulatory priorities.

**Infrastructure, Cloud & Network**

* Own the in-house cloud servers and hosting environment, including capacity, availability and cost.
* Oversee network engineering across all global offices, including connectivity, performance and monitoring.
* Manage Azure and Cloudflare services, including DNS, WAF and Zero Trust.
* Manage internal corporate domains.
* Run telephony systems such as 3CX.

**Corporate Systems, SaaS & Microsoft 365**

* Take responsibility for the company's SaaS portfolio, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, renewals and offboarding.
* Administer Microsoft 365, including tenant security, licensing and governance.
* Own SSO and user registration and provisioning processes, working closely with Security and HR.
* Understand and oversee API integrations between internal and third-party systems.

**IT Service Management (ITSM)**

* Own the ITSM framework: incident, request, change and problem management, with clear SLAs and reporting.
* Ensure the support desk delivers consistent service to every office and time zone.

**Projects & Global Offices**

* Manage IT projects end to end, from scoping and business case through delivery and review.
* Be responsible for IT in all global offices.
* Lead the IT setup for new offices opened across the globe, including network, devices, access, telephony and local compliance needs.

**Security, Business Continuity & Audits**

* Apply security best practice across the IT estate, working with the Security team to protect systems, data and endpoints.
* Own Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans, including regular testing.
* Be responsible for global and internal IT audits, including evidence preparation, auditor coordination and closing findings.

**Required Knowledge & Experience**

* At least 10 years of experience in IT, including 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple technical teams.
* Proven experience running IT across multiple countries or offices, ideally in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.
* Track record of setting up new offices from an IT standpoint.
* Strong hands-on experience with:

Title: Technical Account Manager - Openshift (Remote, Doha with French)
