Description:
Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).

In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.

Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.

The ideal TAM is a team player, enjoys working hard, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, building relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, is able to learn new technologies quickly and uses their time efficiently.

**What you will do:**

  

* Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become an expert on a customer’s implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.
* Perform technical reviews and share knowledge to proactively identify and prevent issues
* Forewarn customers of technology changes or potential disruptions to their service and advice on mitigation strategies.
* Provide advice and guidance to customers about their current and future Red Hat products;
* Troubleshoot technical issues and drive issue escalation with Red Hat and customer teams
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer leadership
* Manage customer use cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans and keep the documentation on the customer's environment updated
* Manage and grow customer relationships by delivering attentive, relationship-based support
* Build a sense of trust with customers and serve as their advocate within Red Hat
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas
* Partner closely with Red Hat Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues
* Travel, as necessary, to visit customers and attend events within the region
* Learn new technologies quickly, including topics like container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, and microservices on container platforms
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat cloud technologies strategy
* Engage with Red Hat’s product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns, based on customer engagements, as well as personal experience, that drive platform adoption
* Engage with Red Hat’s field teams, customers, and partners to ensure a positive cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success

Title: Business Development Manager - Saudi National

* Maintain awareness of pricing, margin performance, risk allocation and contract terms to support profitable, sustainable growth.
* Balance client needs, delivery credibility and commercial outcomes when closing opportunities.

**Propositions and Joint Working**

* Work alongside the Business Development and Advisory teams to shape government, energy, defence and space propositions, bringing client insight and helping validate market need and competitor positioning.
* Contribute to joint propositions and commercial models, including local partnerships and strategic supplier relationships, that showcase end-to-end solutions.
* Support go-to-market activity, including customer segmentation, sales analytics and the packaging of propositions with marketing experts.
* Work with the Advisory team to create an advisory-to-operations pathway that unlocks downstream implementation and long-term contract opportunities.

**Specific Requirements**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience and an established network across Saudi government, semi government organisations, PIF companies and major infrastructure operators.

* Experience in the energy sector (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables or energy services), with a network among key energy-sector stakeholders.

* Bidding and commercial experience on large, complex business opportunities.
* Good understanding of the Saudi business and government landscape, Vision 2030 priorities, and national transformation programmes and investment themes.
* Experience navigating public procurement and relationship-led market development.
* Familiarity with PIF ecosystem dynamics, giga-project stakeholder structures and local partnership models.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities and creating an inclusive environment that proudly celebrates the perspectives and backgrounds that each of our employees bring to work every day.

Title: Lead, Technical Services
Description:
Building on the rapid success and adoption of MongoDB, we are delivering applications and services that make it much easier to manage and scale database deployments. These next-generation systems are a growing list but currently include products such as Atlas, Cloud Manager, and Compass. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity as we scale cloud deployments for our customers.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Toronto for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Life in MongoDB Technical Services
  
  
As part of the Support organization, you will be directly interfacing with our largest customers and their most difficult problems. There will almost certainly be sweat. But don’t worry – you’ll have time to prepare before you take on your first escalation. The limits of your understanding will constantly be pushed, and you’ll be challenged to grow. Underlying it all is the fuel that drives our team: customer obsession. We keep mission-critical deployments online, recover from high-pressure incidents with grace and humility, become trusted advisors, and work so closely with our customers that they would swear we were part of their team.
  
  
Role scope: This is a technical Team Lead role rather than a traditional people-manager role. The Lead is expected to provide day-to-day technical and operational leadership, while formal personnel decisions remain with the manager.
  
  
As the Cloud Support Team Lead, you will:
  
  

* Lead and mentor a small, distributed team as a hands-on technical player-coach
* Spend approximately 50% of your time directly supporting customer issues, complex cases, escalations, and technical investigations.
* Own frontline service quality by monitoring queue health, case and chat aging, diagnostic quality, staffing coverage, and workload allocation
* Lead high-visibility customer escalations and incidents, coordinating Engineering, Product, Support Operations, and other stakeholders
* Turn recurring customer problems and support trends into product feedback, process improvements, training, and reusable technical content
* Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, training materials, and retrospectives that improve team capability and consistency
* Represent Technical Services in cross-functional and cross-region programs, driving execution through influence

Who You Are
  
  

* You are a calm, empathetic technical leader who earns trust with customers, engineers, and cross-functional partners
* You are comfortable leading through influence, ambiguity, and incomplete information
* You use data to identify risks, prioritize work, and allocate team capacity
* You balance hands-on customer support with coaching, quality management, and continuous improvement

What you need
  
  
The ideal candidate will have experience in most of the following areas:
  
  

* Supporting customers through cases, chats, calls, and high-severity escalations. Preferred experience with running high-severity incidents and follow-the-sun procedures
* Leading or mentoring a small team of highly technical support engineers
* Strong troubleshooting experience with MongoDB Atlas or comparable cloud database platforms, including cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, security, storage, and performance
* A disciplined diagnostic process covering investigation, customer communication, escalation judgment, and root-cause analysis. Experience leveraging AI tools to broaden, improve and accelerate technical diagnostic processes preferred
* Coordinating customer-impacting incidents and internal technical responders
* Improving support operations through queue analysis, workload allocation, staffing coverage, training, and process improvement
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across Engineering, Product, Security, Legal, Billing, Support Operations, and global Technical Services

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Cloud Manager, Compass, or large-scale relational or NoSQL databases
* Experience managing FIN(Intercom), chat-support, case-management, or similar customer-support workflows
* Experience leading incident reviews, RCAs, operational audits, or security/compliance improvements
* Experience creating technical training, LMS content, knowledge programs, or enablement assessments
* BONUS: Experience with DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, observability, automation, or scripting

Success Measures
  
  

* First 3 months: Build relationships, understand team operations and customer demand, and begin contributing to complex escalations. Learn the Atlas product and master most common customer use cases
* By 6 months: Independently lead escalations, establish recurring queue and quality reviews, improve coverage, and deliver at least one durable process or enablement improvement. Acquire Atlas Administrator certification
* By 12 months: Demonstrate measurable improvement in service quality, escalation execution, team capability, coverage, and cross-functional delivery while remaining hands-on technically

Description:
Job Description:

**Mackenzie Investments**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

**Additional Information**  

* Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
* Occasional travel may be required.

At Collectivus Holdings, we bring together some of the most recognized and loved brands across the collecting, trading card game, and hobby industries. Backed by a century of collective experience, we’re building what’s next through innovative products, exceptional quality, and unforgettable customer experiences.

Our teams and brands serve passionate communities around the world—and we’re looking for equally passionate people to help us grow.

  

**Website:** https://www.collectivusholdings.com/  
**Global Locations:** Aarhus - Dallas - Delhi - Lisbon - Nashville - Remote Worldwide

**Job Title:** Head of Digital Experiences

**Reporting Line:** CEO

  

Collectivus Holdings is seeking a strategic and execution-focused Head of Digital Experiences to lead the vision, strategy, performance, and the ongoing evolution of our external-facing digital platforms across our portfolio of businesses.

This leader will oversee the digital product strategy and roadmap for our Learning Management System (LMS), Sorted app, and other customer-, retailer-, and partner-facing digital experiences.

The role is responsible for ensuring our digital products deliver meaningful value to users, support business objectives, and create a connected, intuitive experience across the Collectivus ecosystem.

Working closely with business leaders, Technology, Product, Sales, and Operations, this individual will translate business needs into clear digital priorities, partner on scalable software delivery and support processes, and drive measurable results.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Digital Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and own the enterprise-wide strategy for external-facing digital products and experiences.
* Establish a cohesive digital vision across Collectivus businesses while addressing the unique needs of each brand and customer segment.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, retailer adoption, operational efficiency, and revenue through digital solutions.
* Build and manage a prioritized digital roadmap aligned with business objectives, available resources, and expected returns.
* Evaluate new digital opportunities, partnerships, and capabilities that support long-term business growth.

### **Digital Product Ownership**

Provide strategic direction and product leadership for key digital platforms, including:

* **Learning Management System (LMS):** Guide platform development, user experience, educational content delivery capabilities, community engagement, and adoption.
* **Sorted App:** Own the product vision, user experience, feature prioritization, and ongoing evolution of the platform.
* **Additional Digital Experiences:** Provide oversight and strategic alignment for other external-facing websites, applications, portals, and digital tools across the organization.
* Ensure each platform has a defined product strategy, roadmap, ownership structure, and measurable performance expectations.

### **Customer & Partner Experience**

* Champion a customer-first approach to digital product development.
* Ensure digital experiences are intuitive, reliable, accessible, and aligned with customer and partner needs.
* Use customer feedback, usage analytics, and market insights to inform product enhancements.
* Identify opportunities to create more connected experiences across platforms and business units.
* Partner with commercial teams to improve digital adoption, engagement, and customer retention.

### **Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Engineering to translate product requirements into scalable, secure, reliable solutions, with clear accountability for product priorities, engineering execution, and business acceptance.
* Work with business leaders to understand priorities, evaluate requests, and establish clear product requirements.
* Lead product prioritization and make recommendations on resource allocation and investment.
* Establish clear product milestones, acceptance criteria, launch readiness expectations, and accountability for digital initiatives in partnership with delivery teams.
* Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful product development and launches.
* Identify and resolve competing priorities, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Ensure new functionality is supported by appropriate launch, training, and adoption plans.
* Ensure each product has appropriate production-readiness criteria, monitoring, service expectations, documentation, and support arrangements before launch.
* Help establish a scalable keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) operating model for digital products, including service ownership, support processes, incident escalation, and ongoing enhancements.
* Define clear decision rights and handoffs among product, engineering, project delivery, and operations teams, including ownership of requirements, technical delivery, business acceptance, and production support.

### **Business Performance & Accountability**

* Establish KPIs for each digital platform, including revenue and monetization where applicable, user adoption, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Own digital product operating budgets and develop business cases for new digital investments, including anticipated benefits, costs, and ROI.
* Monitor product performance and use data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Provide regular updates to executive leadership on roadmap progress, performance, risks, and investment needs.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing platforms and recommend where to invest, improve, consolidate, or discontinue functionality.

### **Team & Vendor Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing digital product function as business needs evolve.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes across digital initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external development partners, technology vendors, and service providers.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Digital Product Management, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, digital strategy, or platform leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading multiple customer-facing digital products or platforms.
* Strong understanding of product development, user experience, platform integrations, and digital ecosystems.
* Experience with SaaS platforms, mobile applications, LMS platforms, or retailer-facing technology strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to develop digital roadmaps and translate business objectives into actionable product priorities.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, technical resources, and external development partners.
* Strong commercial acumen, including experience evaluating product investments, business cases, and ROI.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and customer insights to improve digital performance.
* Experience operating across multiple businesses, brands, or international markets preferred.

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Strategic Thinking:** Connects digital capabilities to broader business priorities and long-term growth opportunities.
* **Execution & Accountability:** Translates strategy into measurable outcomes, clear ownership, and consistent delivery.
* **Customer Focus:** Understands the needs of retailers, partners, and end users and uses those insights to guide decisions.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Evaluates digital investments based on business value, adoption, cost, and return.
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Builds alignment across business and technical teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.
* **Pragmatic Problem-Solving:** Balances innovation with business realities, prioritizing solutions that deliver meaningful results.

**Measures of Success**
-----------------------

Success in this role will be evaluated through:

* Delivery against an approved, prioritized digital product roadmap.
* Increased adoption and engagement across LMS, Sorted, and other digital platforms.
* Improved customer and partner experience, measured through feedback and product performance.
* Achievement of agreed commercial and operational KPIs for each platform.
* On-time delivery of key digital initiatives within approved budgets.
* Clear product ownership, prioritization, and accountability across the organization.
* Demonstrated business value and return on digital investments.

Title: Manager - Cybersecurity
Location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Manager of Cyber Security is responsible for leading the enterprise cyber security strategy, operations, and governance across on-premises and cloud environments. This role oversees a dedicated cyber security team responsible for protecting infrastructure (Windows/Linux servers, cloud platforms: Oracle, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes clusters, enterprise networking, and databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL, CouchDB). The Manager ensures compliance with industry regulations, reduces cyber risks, and implements proactive security measures to safeguard critical business systems and data.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic & Governance**

* Develop and implement the organization’s cyber security roadmap aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Establish security policies, standards, and procedures across infrastructure, cloud, and application environments.
* Collaborate with the Manager of Cloud & Infrastructure Services or Technology Infrastructure Manager to embed security into system and network architecture.
* Manage security budgets, vendor relationships, and third-party risk assessments.
* Ensure compliance with standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, or local regulatory requirements.

**Operational Security**

* Oversee Security Operations Centre (SOC) activities, including monitoring, threat detection, and incident response.
* Manage vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and remediation plans.
* Implement and maintain security controls for servers, networks, cloud services, Kubernetes, and databases.
* Lead incident response and forensic investigations, ensuring timely resolution and root cause analysis.
* Ensure strong identity and access management (IAM), privilege escalation control, and zero-trust practices.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued
  
  
**Risk Management & Assurance**

* Conduct regular risk assessments and security audits across IT infrastructure and applications.
* Manage enterprise endpoint protection, intrusion detection/prevention (IDS/IPS), and SIEM platforms.
* Drive awareness and training programs to promote a strong cyber security culture across the organization.
* Oversee data protection measures, encryption standards, and backup/recovery procedures.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a dedicated cyber security team including analysts, engineers, and incident responders.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for cyber defence and resilience.
* Provide continuous skill development to stay ahead of evolving threats and technologies.

**People Management**

* Provides direction, coaching and guidance to team members for their career and professional development.
* Creates a conducive working environment to build and sustain a performance driven, engaged, and committed team.
* Ensures people management responsibilities are handled effectively in line with company procedures.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor’s degree in cyber security, Information Technology, or related field (master’s preferred).
* CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, CCSP, or equivalent industry certifications.
* Cloud security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, Oracle Security).
* Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) is a plus.
* Fluent in English Language
* Strong background securing Windows/Linux servers, cloud (AWS, Azure, Oracle), and enterprise networks.
* Knowledge of enterprise databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, MySQL, CouchDB) and their security best practices.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Work Experience
  
  

* With 8+ years of IT security experience, with at least 3+ years in a managerial role.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes security, container hardening, and cloud-native security tools.
* Proven track record in leading incident response and crisis management.

* Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
* Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
* Work alongside multidisciplinary teams on complex transformation initiatives.
* Help shape the future of business and technology transformation across the region.

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing
Description:
Requisition ID: 279434
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

  

**The Role**

  

Shape the future of Technology Sourcing at Scotiabank

  

Scotiabank's Procurement function is at a pivotal moment — driving strategic value, commercial discipline, and innovation as the Bank accelerates its digital and AI transformation. As Senior Manager, Technology Sourcing, you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology categories.

  

You'll partner with Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, and senior business leaders to unlock enterprise value across SaaS, cloud & hyperscalers, infrastructure, software, IT labour, networks, and emerging tech. This is a role for a commercially sharp procurement leader who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing spend decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes beyond savings.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for enterprise technology categories from opportunity assessment and market intelligence through negotiation, contracting, and benefits realization.
* Build category strategies across SaaS, cloud, software licensing, IT professional services, infrastructure, and telecom anchored in spend analysis, supplier capability, and market trends.

* Track and report pipeline, benefits, milestones, and commitments with discipline and transparency.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Technology stakeholders and an escalation point on commercial and supplier matters with enterprise impact.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related; CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent is preferred.
* 5–10+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or supplier management — with meaningful exposure to technology categories.
* Deep familiarity with SaaS pricing models, cloud consumption economics, software licensing (perpetual, subscription, token-based), IT labour rate cards, and MSA/SOW constructs.

* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders (VP/SVP) and lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity.

* Understanding of third-party risk and regulatory expectations in financial services (or another regulated environment) is an asset.
* Familiarity with e-sourcing, CLM, and supplier management platforms.

  

**What’s in it for you?**

  

* A rewarding career path with diverse opportunities for professional development
* An organization committed to making a difference in our communities – for you and our customers.
* A competitive rewards program includes annual bonus, flexible vacation, personal and sick days, and comprehensive benefits that start on your first day.

We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employees to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.

Description:
19 Nov 2026

3 Dec 2026 - 00:00 UTC

Worldwide

Communications and Media

  

**ROLE PURPOSE**
  
The Program Communication Manager leads and assures high-quality, ethical, inclusive, evidence-based, and results-oriented communication for humanitarian programmes and projects, strengthening community engagement and accountability, supporting programme delivery and learning, meeting donor and contractual communication obligations, and documenting outcomes and impact.
  
The Program Communication Manager leads the planning, coordination, delivery, and monitoring of communication across humanitarian programmes and projects. The role ensures that communication is integrated throughout the programme and project lifecycle—from design and proposal development through implementation, monitoring, reporting, learning, and close-out—and that it contributes to programme quality, community engagement, accountability, donor requirements, visibility, and evidence of results.
  
**KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY**
  
**Programme and Project Communication Strategy and Planning**

* Develop and maintain programme/project communication strategies, plans, objectives, audience profiles, key messages, channels, timelines, responsibilities, budgets, and performance indicators.
* Ensure communication is considered at programme design and proposal stage, including communication needs, community information requirements, donor visibility, consent, safeguarding, accessibility, and risk.
* Translate programme objectives and theories of change into clear communication outcomes and audience-specific approaches.
* Coordinate communication plans across multiple programmes and projects to avoid duplication, identify shared opportunities, and manage competing priorities.
* Review plans regularly in response to context changes, community feedback, programme performance, emerging risks, and donor requirements.
* Lead the annual programme communication materials cycle (September to November): evaluate the previous year’s materials and publication performance, consolidate material needs from each project, and draft the annual plan of programme communication materials (objectives, audiences, key messages, material types, quarterly targets per project, and budget) aligned with the organizational communication strategy and master narrative, for approval by the Humanitarian & Program Operations Director.
* Work with the Brand and Comms Manager to align the approved annual plan with the organization’s annual publication calendar.

**Humanitarian Communication and Community Engagement**

* Oversee communication approaches that help affected communities access accurate, timely, understandable, accessible, and actionable information.
* Support two-way communication, community engagement, feedback, complaints referral, and information-sharing in coordination with programme teams and accountability/MEAL colleagues.
* Ensure communication is context-sensitive, conflict-sensitive, gender- and disability-inclusive, culturally appropriate, and adapted to language, literacy, age, and access needs.
* Coordinate communication support for preparedness, emergency response, recovery, risk communication, and other humanitarian programme phases as relevant to the organization’s mandate.
* Apply the humanitarian principles (humanity, neutrality, impartiality, and independence) and the do-no-harm principle in all programme communication, including communication with affected communities.
* During emergency response, prepare key messages, situation updates, and rapid-response information products with field operations and designated organizational spokespeople, aligned with the humanitarian response category (set by the humanitarian function within the first 24 hours) and delivered in line with the Categorization Framework in the Communication and Media Protocols, such as social media statements and blog posts (2 to 6 hours), press releases, case examples, and photographs (24 hours), and case studies (48 hours), in coordination with Strategic Communications.
* Ensure emergency communication carries the organization’s key humanitarian messages (scale of the emergency, impact on children, the response, advocacy asks, and appeal and fundraising needs), focuses on children and their long-term needs, speaks with one voice, and supports child protection and children’s rights.
* Ensure communication materials do not expose affected people, staff, partners, or communities to avoidable safety, protection, privacy, or reputational risks.

**Project Communication, Visibility, and Donor Compliance**

* Lead planning and delivery of project communication outputs, including stories of change, case studies, photographs, videos, social content, factsheets, human-interest materials, field updates, and communication inputs to reports.
* Translate donor visibility and acknowledgement requirements into practical workplans and quality checks, in coordination with grants, partnerships, programme, and Strategic Communications teams.
* Track communication deliverables and deadlines stated in proposals, grant agreements, contracts, communication plans, and donor guidance.
* Coordinate content collection with field teams and partners while minimizing disruption to programme delivery and avoiding extractive or harmful storytelling practices.
* Apply branding, marking, and co-branding rules to programme materials, including logo sequencing with donor and partner logos and logo proportions (a partner logo is never larger than the organization’s logo); where a donor specifies requirements, follow the donor’s procedure.

**Content Quality, Editorial Oversight, and Production**

* Set practical editorial, visual, accessibility, and quality standards for programme/project communication products, consistent with organizational policies and brand guidance.
* Oversee the editorial process from brief and commissioning through drafting, fact-checking, review, approval, production, publication, and archiving, acting as the initiator in the sign-off process: draft or commission the product, ensure relevant staff and resource persons have provided input and verified data, obtain sign-off from the decision maker, disseminate the product internally, and keep the record.
* Coordinate translation, interpretation, captioning, alternative formats, and local-language review as required.
* Maintain a content calendar and production pipeline, prioritizing urgent, contractual, high-impact, and time-sensitive deliverables.
* Chair the monthly materials planning meeting (final week of each month) to agree the materials to be produced and assign tasks, and ensure every brief is recorded in the material tracker before production begins.
* Review each programme material for accuracy, evidence, clarity, respectful and audience-appropriate content, and conformity with organizational values, the brand guideline, master narrative and key messages, donor visibility requirements, and the safeguarding checklist, completing each review round within two working days.
* Submit the complete publication package (final files, accompanying text, approval reference number, channel, and date) to Strategic Communications at least three working days before the planned publication date, and five to seven working days ahead where donor approval is required; for website and social media requests, state the content objectives, any partnership agreement conditions, and tagging details.
* Plan production schedules around the approval lead times in the Communication and Media Protocols (designed materials: two working days; media-relation items: three working days; national press releases: five; regional or global press releases: seven).
* Develop and approve programme and project content (such as project pages, field updates, and donor deliverables) and submit it to Strategic Communications, which holds publication rights for all official channels and media relations; neither the Manager nor programme and project staff publish programme materials directly or open social media accounts unless approved by Strategic Communications and recorded in the official account list. These procedures apply to programme and project materials, not organization-level materials.
* Ensure photography and video follow the organization’s imagery principles: focus on or refer to children, show staff naturally at work, pair imagery with copy that fits its objective, and capture authentic, unposed moments with context.

**Impact Communication, Evidence, Learning, and Reporting**

* Work with MEAL and programme teams to identify credible evidence of outputs, outcomes, community perspectives, and change; distinguish verified results from aspirations or anecdotal claims.
* Develop ethical and compelling narratives that explain the context, intervention, contribution, limitations, and observed changes without overstating attribution or impact.
* Define and monitor communication indicators such as reach, engagement, comprehension, feedback responsiveness, content quality, timeliness, and compliance.
* Produce regular performance updates, lessons learned, and recommendations for improving communication and programme practice.
* Ensure communication evidence is used to support programme learning, adaptive management, donor reporting, and appropriate external communication.

**Team Leadership and People Management**

* Directly manage, coach, and develop the Humanitarian Communication Coordinator and Project Communication Coordinator.
* Agree annual or project-based objectives, workplans, role clarity, performance indicators, and professional development priorities with each direct report.
* Allocate work and resources according to programme priorities, staff capacity, deadlines, context, and risk; resolve conflicting requests and escalate resource gaps.
* Conduct regular one-to-ones, team planning meetings, performance reviews, feedback, and learning sessions.
* Promote a respectful, inclusive, collaborative, and psychologically safe team culture, with clear standards for accountability and professional conduct.
* Identify staffing, consultant, vendor, equipment, and training needs and submit recommendations through the appropriate management and budget processes.

**Budget, Procurement, and Resource Management**

* Develop and manage communication budgets for assigned programmes/projects in coordination with budget holders and finance colleagues.
* Monitor expenditure, forecasts, cost-effectiveness, and budget compliance; flag variances and propose corrective action.
* Prepare scopes of work and technical briefs for photographers, videographers, designers, translators, printers, agencies, and other service providers.
* Support procurement and vendor selection in line with organizational policies, value-for-money principles, safeguarding requirements, and delegated approval limits.
* Maintain appropriate controls over equipment, digital assets, subscriptions, content production, and other communication resources.

**Risk Management, Safeguarding, Consent, and Data Protection**

* Apply organizational policies on safeguarding, protection, confidentiality, informed consent, data protection, information security, and responsible storytelling.
* Ensure consent is informed, voluntary, specific, appropriately documented, and revisited where context or intended use changes; consent must not be treated as a substitute for risk assessment.
* Use heightened safeguards for children and adults at heightened risk, including appropriate permissions, assent where relevant, anonymization, and review of potential harm.
* Assess risks associated with publication, geolocation, identifiable images, sensitive narratives, political or conflict contexts, and disclosure of operational information.
* Escalate suspected safeguarding concerns, data incidents, misinformation, harmful content, or serious reputational risks through established reporting channels promptly.
* Ensure team members and contractors understand and follow relevant policies before collecting, storing, producing, or publishing content.

**Coordination and Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Humanitarian & Program Operations Director, programme managers, project managers, field teams, MEAL, safeguarding, grants, finance, partnerships, and resource mobilization colleagues.
* Coordinate with Strategic Communications on organizational messages, brand identity, public statements, media engagement, sensitive topics, and content with organization-wide reputational implications.
* Pass programme content proposed for organization-level channels (website, main social media accounts, press releases) to Strategic Communications with consent, attribution, context, and usage rights documented.
* Strengthen partner capacity and ensure implementing partners apply the Communication and Media Protocols in both normal and emergency situations, that partnership agreements state that branding and marking follow the Protocols, and that partners are oriented on sign-off and co-branding requirements.
* Clarify roles, review steps, approval authority, escalation triggers, and response timelines with relevant teams to reduce bottlenecks and conflicting messages.
* Represent programme/project communication in relevant planning, review, coordination, and learning forums.
* Lead programme/project communication plans, delivery pipelines, field-oriented content, community communication, project visibility, and programme-level performance reporting within delegated authority, complementing the Strategic Communications function, which leads organization-wide positioning, institutional narrative, brand stewardship, media strategy, executive communications, and organization-level reputation.
* Agree and document coordination arrangements with Strategic Communications covering brand and editorial standards, publication workflows, escalation triggers, crisis coordination, and how programme evidence contributes to institutional narratives, supported by regular (weekly or bi-weekly) coordination meetings, a shared content calendar, and common brand and messaging guidelines.

**Crisis, Issues, and Incident Communication**

* Maintain programme/project-level communication risk assessments and escalation procedures in coordination with programme leadership and Strategic Communications.
* Support timely, accurate, and coordinated information for operational incidents, rapidly changing contexts, community concerns, and emerging misinformation.
* Provide verified programme facts, audience analysis, and field context to designated organizational spokespeople and decision-makers.
* Route all media enquiries to the Brand and Comms Manager; do not speak to the media unless designated as an authorized spokesperson, and do not issue institutional positions, media statements, or high-risk public responses outside delegated authority. Sensitive, political, and organizational matters are handled by the CEO; obtain required approvals and follow incident protocols.
* Participate in after-action reviews and update communication plans based on lessons learned.
* Provide verified facts and corrections for issues linked to programme materials, working with the response lead for the issue level: routine issues (isolated negative comments, misunderstandings) are answered by the Brand and Comms Manager with substantive clarification from the Program Communication Manager within one working day; issues (widespread criticism, misinformation about programmes, errors in published material, media questions) are co-led with the Sr. Manager Strategic Communications and the Program Manager within four hours; crises (safeguarding or privacy breaches, safety risks, impact on donor or government relationships) are supported with facts and corrections, with an interim statement within two hours; record each case in the programme communication issue and incident log and supply corrections to Strategic Communications.
* Support take-down decisions when consent is withdrawn or a content error is found by supplying facts; the decision and removal (each within 24 hours) rest with Strategic Communications.
* Be consulted on the same-day referral to the Safeguarding Focal Point (immediately where there is a risk of harm) of any report of abuse, exploitation, or a person at risk received through publication channels on programme content.
* Escalate statements on sensitive political or conflict issues, major incidents, allegations, high-risk media requests, CEO/board matters, and issues with organization-wide reputational impact through the designated approval and incident protocols, without bypassing reporting lines or assuming approval authority not explicitly delegated.

**Systems, Knowledge Management, and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate, organized, secure, and accessible records and repositories of approved content, source files, approvals, consent, attribution, usage rights, donor acknowledgements and visibility evidence, published outputs, and communication reports.
* Establish repeatable workflows, templates, briefing formats, quality-assurance checklists, and approval tracking for programme/project communication.
* Promote appropriate use of digital tools, analytics, multimedia, and accessible formats while following organizational data and security requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce duplication, strengthen local capacity, and increase the usefulness of communication to communities and programme teams.
* Ensure proper handover, archiving, and closure of communication assets and obligations at project end.

**Field Content, Livestreaming, and Rapid Publishing**

* Lead planning of field content for visits by the Program Communication Team: prepare the Field Content Plan (location, period, channel, format, risk level, and content objectives) at least ten working days before departure, and obtain pre-approval from the Sr. Manager Strategic Communications (or the decision maker for the risk level) before travel; pre-approval is valid only for the location, period, channel, and format stated in the plan.
* Ensure only staff designated as focal points by Strategic Communications, trained and listed under the Spokesperson Appointment Policy, produce and publish field content, using official devices and temporary publication access only; personal devices must not be used to access official accounts. The procedure covers the organization’s official Instagram (Live and Story) and YouTube (Live and Shorts) accounts.
* Ensure informed consent is obtained before filming or photographing, in coordination with the Safeguarding Focal Point and the Program Manager.
* Oversee live broadcasts and quick content so that they follow the approved plan, pass the content checklist before publication, and are approved at the level set by the risk-based approval matrix under Decision-Making Authority.
* Ensure immediate action when an incident occurs: the team stops the broadcast, redirects the camera, or takes down quick content when a person without consent is recorded, personal data or a sensitive location is visible, security conditions change or an objection is raised, a participant is distressed or asks to stop, or Strategic Communications requests it. Report the incident to the responsible manager and the Brand and Comms Manager within 30 minutes, and report lost or damaged official devices immediately.
* Ensure publication access is returned and official devices are handed back within one working day after the team returns, and that the post-field report (reach, engagement, donations where relevant, and incidents) is completed within five working days.
* Evaluate the livestreaming and quick-content procedure each quarter (including the November review) with the Fundraising Manager, and update it with Strategic Communications, the Safeguarding Focal Point, and the Technology and Digital Unit.

**Fundraising and Resource Mobilization Support**

* Provide programme communication support for fundraising and resource mobilization across all income streams, including institutional donors, individual giving, Islamic giving, domestic and international corporate partners, and other sources, in line with priorities agreed with the Humanitarian & Program Operations Director and the fundraising teams.
* Supply verified programme facts, results, stories of change, case studies, photographs, and videos for concept notes, proposals, pitch materials, appeals, campaigns, and donor or partner reports, tailored to each audience and income stream.
* Contribute communication and visibility plans, budgets, and evidence of results to institutional donor proposals and reports, in coordination with the grants and partnerships teams.
* Support individual giving and Islamic giving campaigns and supporter updates with authentic programme content and impact information that accurately reflects how funds are used, following the requirements set by the responsible fundraising teams.
* Support domestic and international corporate partnerships with programme content for partnership proposals, employee engagement, co-branded materials, and impact reporting, applying the organization’s branding and co-branding rules.
* Support donor and corporate partner field visits, emergency appeals, and fundraising field content, obtaining approvals under the risk-based approval matrix, and ensure fundraising use of programme content respects consent scope, safeguarding, data protection, and donor restrictions, without overstating results or using extractive imagery.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
  
**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, media studies, development studies, international relations, or a related field.
* Typically 5–7 years of progressively responsible experience in communications, including experience supporting programmes/projects; relevant organizational context may justify a different threshold.

**Experience and Skills**

* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing communication plans and producing high-quality written, visual, and digital content.
* Experience coordinating multiple deliverables, stakeholders, deadlines, and budgets.
* Experience with donor visibility requirements, ethical storytelling, consent, safeguarding, and risk-sensitive communications.
* Experience managing or supervising staff, consultants, agencies, or production vendors.
* Programme/project cycle management and ability to integrate communication into design, implementation, monitoring, reporting, and learning.
* Strong writing, editing, interviewing, storytelling, briefing, and content quality-assurance skills in the working languages of the role (for example Bahasa Indonesia and English), including review of translated materials.
* Understanding of community engagement, accountability to affected populations, inclusive communication, and accessible information.
* Understanding of safeguarding, informed consent, privacy, data protection, and responsible representation of affected people.
* Knowledge of donor visibility and communication compliance processes, branding and co-branding rules, sign-off and risk-based approval processes, and live and short-form video publishing on social media platforms.
* Ability to use digital publishing tools, content management systems, social media tools, analytics, and common office/productivity software.
* Budgeting, work planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, and basic performance measurement.

**Desirable**

* A relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Experience producing communication content for fundraising, such as institutional donor proposals, individual or Islamic giving campaigns, and corporate partnerships.
* Experience in humanitarian action, international development, civil society, or community-based programming is strongly preferred.

Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:
**About Blackbird Health**

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we're growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you'll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that's shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you're passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

**Position Summary**

Blackbird Health is looking to hire a Technical Program Manager (TPM), Clinical Data & Operations to join our growing Data & Technology team. This role will own the end-to-end delivery of our clinical data initiatives—serving as the strategic engine for clinical operations. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data and Technology, you will translate complex operational bottlenecks (provider capacity, patient throughput, scheduling workflows) into scalable data products. Leveraging our modern cloud data stack (Snowflake, AWS, GCP, and dbt), you will define KPIs, eliminate manual reporting, and operationalize data so our clinics run as efficiently as possible. This is not a traditional TPM role. You won't just coordinate roadmaps or track deliverables; you will build analytics solutions from prototype to production partnering with respective experts in the organization.

**What makes you, you:**

* **Player-Coach Mentality:** You are comfortable leading projects strategically while also rolling up your sleeves to write SQL or build data models when needed to unblock your team.
* **Clarity of Thought:** You can translate ambiguous clinical and operational challenges into precise technical requirements and clear strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
* **Empathy & Integrity:** You lead with heart and high EQ, understanding the day-to-day stress of clinical directors and framing data as a tool to help them, not police them.
* **Operations Obsessed:** You don't just look at numbers; you deeply understand how clinics actually run in the real world and care about the human impact of your workflows.
* **Ambiguity Navigator:** You thrive when handed a vague business problem, quickly structuring it into a clear, actionable technical project and agile roadmap.

**How you'll make an impact:**

* **Technical Program Management & Delivery:** Own the data product roadmap for clinical operations; scope, prioritize, and drive the execution of complex data projects from initial concept to production delivery.
* Translate ambiguous clinical and operational challenges into precise technical requirements and data models.
* Manage cross-functional project lifecycles, acting as the primary bridge between clinical leadership, engineering, and operations teams to ensure data solutions are adopted and effective.
* **Clinical Operations & Change Management:** Deeply analyze provider utilization, appointment scheduling, wait times, and capacity planning to build predictive models that anticipate resource constraints.
* Map and evaluate existing clinical workflows, identifying operational bottlenecks and leading data-backed process improvement initiatives.
* Drive change management across the clinical team; ensure clinical leaders understand the data, trust the insights, and actually use them to change how their teams operate.
* Track the operational and financial ROI of implemented data products and workflow adjustments over time.
* **Data Architecture & Pipeline Oversight:** Tackle complex, unstructured clinical data (including EHR feeds, notes, and third-party data) to build robust, scalable analytics workflows.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance (and execution when necessary) using **dbt** to build, test, and maintain clean data models within our **Snowflake** environment, hosted across **AWS/GCP**.
* Ensure strict adherence to **HIPAA** compliance, data security, and patient privacy standards in all data models and reporting outputs.

**The basics you'll need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, data product management, or a senior analytics role heavily embedded in clinical operations.
* Deep, practical understanding of clinic operations (e.g., provider scheduling, utilization metrics, patient throughput).
* Strong understanding of modern cloud data warehouse architecture (specifically Snowflake, with exposure to AWS or GCP environments).
* Experience with or strong conceptual understanding of dbt (data build tool) for data modeling and pipeline transformation.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience with modern BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) to build compelling data narratives.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA regulations and data governance best practices in healthcare.
* Proficiency with agile methodologies and modern project tracking tools (Jira, Linear, Asana, etc.).

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with clinical interoperability standards and data formats, specifically HL7 and FHIR, as well as billing codes (ICD-10, CPT).
* Expert-level understanding of workflows within major Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
* Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis and predictive modeling.

**Why Blackbird is unique:**

* **High-Impact Ownership:** Direct opportunities to shape how our clinics run and directly improve the mental healthcare experience for families.
* **Modern Tech Stack:** Autonomy to build scalable solutions using best-in-class cloud and analytics engineering tools.
* **Leadership Impact:** You will report directly to technology leadership and act as a key liaison across the entire clinical organization.
* Supportive work culture

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision coverage (available on day 1 of employment)
* 401k (with a company match)
* Employer-paid life insurance coverage
* Generous paid time off
* Opportunities for career growth
* Final compensation determined based on experience

**Join us!**

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child's brain, body, and behavior work together.

"It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this-from testing to therapy to med management (and more)-all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone."

**Fostering an inclusive environment:**

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

*Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.*

### **Description and Requirements**

**The Opportunity**

Email is one of MetLife’s highest-volume and most business-critical marketing channels, supporting many programs across customer and employer audiences. Delivering that volume reliably, compliantly, and efficiently depends on a disciplined operating model: well-defined intake, consistent production and quality control, a well-managed execution vendor, and full use of the email technology MetLife has invested in.

Reporting to the Director, e-Business Marketing, Email Operations will drive operational excellence at scale for the email team and making sure every send is accurate, on time, compliant, and measured. This individual will strengthen intake, production, AI-enabled quality control, deliverability, and vendor performance, and will partner with Global Marketing Technology to get full value from the email platforms. As email shifts from batch sends toward repeatable customer journeys, the role will also partner with the journey and automation manager to operationalize that shift.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end email operations, including intake, production, quality control, deliverability, vendor management, and continuous process improvement to increase efficiency, quality, and speed-to-market.
* Manage a structured intake and prioritization process, including request triage, capacity planning, service-level tracking, and stakeholder collaboration to ensure clear requirements and optimal resource allocation.
* Oversee email production standards, templates, and quality assurance processes, including proofing, rendering and device testing, personalization validation, compliance reviews, and incident management with root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Fueling for Data Center**
================================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager leads Cat5’s preventive maintenance and fueling program for a national wireless infrastructure client, with a fleet made up mostly of portable generators. The role coordinates scheduled maintenance, routine and emergency fuel deliveries, portable unit deployment and recovery, field personnel and vendors, safety, client communications, and complete service and fuel-delivery documentation.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

  

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

  

**Location**

Mostly on-site in North Texas, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

  

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.

* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).

* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.

* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, on-time fueling, emergency response, fuel-delivery accuracy and work-order closeout.

* Protect client confidential information.

* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.

* Track every scheduled maintenance visit and fueling commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and fueling operations**

* Oversee scheduled preventive maintenance inspections and servicing of portable generators and, where applicable, installed generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

* Review maintenance findings, identify deficiencies and coordinate escalation of repair needs to the appropriate repair team for client approval.

* Plan recurring generator fueling, fuel-level checks and emergency refueling based on client requirements, site access and generator operating needs.

* Coordinate routine portable generator checks, operational testing and follow-up on deficiencies identified during preventive maintenance, including ATS checks where applicable.

* Enforce quality standards through maintenance checklists, fuel-delivery tickets, meter readings, photographs and complete site-level work-order records.

* Investigate missed services, fueling discrepancies, fuel shortages and repeat service issues; document corrective actions.

* Ensure preventive maintenance and fueling activities follow applicable safety, spill-prevention, environmental and fuel-handling requirements.

* Ensure technicians record generator condition, alarms, fluid levels, battery checks, fuel levels and test results during service visits.

* Obtain required client approvals for nonroutine fueling, emergency deliveries and out-of-scope maintenance before proceeding.

* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and fueling history for each serviced asset and site.

* Track portable generator inventory, location, deployment, transport and return, recording unit ID, run hours and condition at each move.

* Coordinate qualified maintenance subcontractors, fuel suppliers and delivery partners when work cannot be self-performed.

* Escalate generator faults, fuel-system concerns, suspected leaks and repair needs with supporting site documentation.

**Fuel, parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of preventive maintenance supplies, filters, fluids and approved fueling resources.

* Forecast maintenance supplies and fuel-delivery demand based on schedules, site consumption and seasonal or emergency needs.

* Publish reports on fuel deliveries, consumption, maintenance supplies, missed visits and service delays.

* Coordinate approved fuel suppliers and maintenance-material vendors, including delivery coverage and service expectations.

* Record maintenance materials, delivered fuel quantities, delivery confirmations and associated costs in designated systems.

* Use maintenance schedules, historical fuel usage and generator run time to plan service materials and fueling requirements.

* Review fuel-supply capacity, delivery lead times and critical maintenance materials with the client.

* Support client audits of maintenance records, fuel tickets, invoices and vendor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes, fueling dispatches and portable generator deployments based on geography, site priority and personnel qualifications.

* Monitor technician and fuel-vendor productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.

* Coordinate follow-up maintenance visits, missed fuel deliveries and client communication for incomplete work.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site preventive maintenance schedules, fueling routes, dispatch priorities and travel logistics.

* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel deliveries within contractual service windows.

* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, low-fuel conditions and delivery delays; keep the client informed.

* Track maintenance and fueling work orders, assigned personnel, delivery dates, gallons delivered and outstanding actions.

* Close out each work order with service details, fuel quantities, delivery tickets, photographs and client-required documentation.

* Investigate recurring service exceptions, fuel discrepancies, incomplete deliveries and quality concerns.

* Ensure proper handling of fuels and service waste, including spill response and reporting under applicable procedures.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, routine fueling, emergency refueling and portable generator deployment at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.

* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, maintenance, fuel logistics or telecom infrastructure.

* 3+ years working with portable and standby diesel or natural gas generators; automatic transfer switch (ATS) experience is a plus.

* Working knowledge of Generac, Kohler and other portable generator platforms and their controllers.

* Experience managing generator preventive maintenance and fueling programs with field documentation and quality controls.

* Experience with fuel logistics, delivery verification, vendor coordination and maintenance-material planning.

* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.

* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, fueling requirements and service scopes.

* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.

* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.

* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.

* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.

* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.

* Experience with generator fueling, emergency fuel delivery, fuel monitoring and remote field service.

* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.

* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.

* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in North Texas, with coordination of remote field operations.

* Travel to fuel vendors, maintenance partners and field sites, up to 40% of the time.

* Availability outside normal hours for emergency fueling, portable generator deployment, generator outages and storm response.

* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.

* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion, fueling delivery and work-order closeout.

* Fueling dispatch, emergency delivery and maintenance response within contract requirements.

* Every maintenance visit and fuel delivery documented with required readings, quantities and asset identification.

* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.

* Improved generator readiness, fewer low-fuel incidents and timely resolution of maintenance deficiencies.

* Accurate fuel reconciliation, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.

* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.
