In this newly created role, you will own the technology roadmap from strategy through execution, with accountability for modernization priorities, investment decisions, platform reliability, and measurable business outcomes. You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, partner with the Director, Development, and establish the technical direction and capabilities needed to deliver on our product vision while supporting the customers who depend on our technology.

*This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Shape a meaningful transformation.* You will have the autonomy to challenge established approaches, make consequential technology decisions, and guide the evolution of a business-critical software platform. You will see the impact of your work in stronger platform capabilities, improved delivery, and better customer experiences.

*Build what comes next.* You will lead experienced teams while shaping the standards, capabilities, and ways of working needed for the future. From strengthening engineering practices to developing technical leaders, you will have the opportunity to build a more effective technology organization and see the results of your leadership.

*Grow your executive influence.* You will work directly with the General Manager and contribute to decisions that connect technology investments with customer needs and business growth. Backed by Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network, you will have opportunities to expand your leadership experience and pursue broader responsibilities over time.

**As our new Director, Technology, you will**

* **Own the technology roadmap.** You will turn the product vision into a multi-year strategy with clear priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking accountability for delivery and results. You will establish architectural standards, technology governance, and engineering priorities. Partnering with the Director, Development, you will strengthen technical decision-making, CI/CD, automation, and delivery practices across Canadian and offshore teams.
* **Lead platform modernization.** You will define a phased approach to evolving AXIS, including its legacy Rocket UniVerse architecture. You will determine what to retain, integrate, replace, or modernize, guiding decisions on APIs, application architecture, CRM, data capabilities, and cloud or hybrid environments while protecting the reliability customers depend on.
* **Turn innovation into impact.** You will identify opportunities to improve CRM capabilities, business intelligence, reporting, and operational efficiency through AI, automation, and better use of data. You will evaluate feasibility and business value, establish priorities, and work with technical teams to turn promising initiatives into measurable results.
* **Strengthen security and reliability.** You will oversee infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.
* **Build and grow technical capabilities.** You will lead the Architecture and Infrastructure & Security teams, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and identify capability gaps. You will improve collaboration with Development and Product to ensure teams have the direction and support needed to execute the roadmap.
* **Connect technology to business priorities.** You will partner with the General Manager on technology investments, budgets, resources, and strategic decisions. You will communicate risks and trade-offs, measure progress, and contribute technical leadership to customer conversations when needed.

**You bring**

* **The senior technology leadership.** You have led technology strategy, architecture, and technical teams within an enterprise software business, with accountability for investment decisions, organizational performance, and business outcomes. You bring the judgment to set direction, establish priorities, and deliver results through technical leaders and cross-functional teams.
* **The platform modernization expertise.** You have led the evolution of complex, business-critical software, navigating legacy architecture, technical debt, and customer dependencies. You know how to assess what to retain, replace, or integrate, develop a phased modernization roadmap, and introduce new capabilities without compromising reliability.
* **The technical depth.** You bring strong expertise in enterprise architecture, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud or hybrid environments, along with an understanding of infrastructure, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. You can establish technical standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and guide decisions that strengthen platform performance, security, and scalability.
* **The experience driving innovation.** You have improved engineering practices and delivery performance across distributed teams, including those outside your direct reporting structure. You understand CI/CD, automation, and modern development practices, and can identify practical opportunities for AI, analytics, and business intelligence that deliver measurable value.
* **The business acumen.** You connect technology decisions to customer needs, financial priorities, and long-term business growth. You can evaluate investments, communicate complex trade-offs, and align senior leaders while staying close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions and guide execution.
* **The influence.** You develop strong technical leaders, establish accountability, and build cross-functional, cross-location collaboration. You are comfortable making difficult decisions, navigating competing priorities, and owning outcomes in an environment where you have the autonomy to shape what comes next.

**Why join?**

Axis Campana and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

**Compensation**

At Campana and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 to $200,000 plus bonus.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

**Apply now.**

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

**What you can expect from our interview process:**

Description:

Translate security and compliance risk into clear business decisions for executives, customers and auditors and ensure teams have the strategy, priorities and direction needed to strengthen Skillable’s security posture.

**What You Will Do:**

* Own security operations, including identity, cloud security, vulnerability management and threat detection and response.
* Build a detection and response as code practice, using AI agents to triage alerts and automate response, with detections and playbooks managed in version control and tested.
* Own risk management, security policies and the SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 audit programs.

* 8+ years of information security experience across security operations and compliance.
* 2+ years of professional work experience in a leadership position. Direct management oversight required.
* Action oriented in thoughtfully evaluating how and where AI can enhance work, while applying sound judgment, critical thinking, and appropriate human oversight.
* Natural curiosity and adaptability in learning, adopting and applying emerging AI capabilities to evolve ways of working across individual responsibilities and departments.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing people, as well as, promoting best practices and standards within department and industry.

Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Operations – Generator Services

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

Full-time, exempt

------------------------

This role will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy, and patient support operations for a rare disease product, with an initial focus on the successful commercialization of the new product launch. The role will also collaborate closely with Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure a seamless patient and provider experience.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Specialty Distribution Partner Management:**

* Support day-to-day operational execution across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services, ensuring coordination with internal teams and timely escalation of operational barriers.Partner with vendor program managers across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services to support operational activities, monitor open issues, and facilitate timely issue resolution and follow-up actions.

* Monitor and maintain operational performance standards with specialty distribution partners, ensuring alignment with agreed-upon service levels, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate resolution of operational barriers involving prescription processing, medical benefit reimbursement, buy-and-bill, institutional procurement, billing and claims, and alignment of product delivery with treatment scheduling, engaging appropriate functional experts as needed. Create and manage various channel/SD/SP communications and documents

* Work closely with the Channel Operations team to monitor/maintain optimal inventory levels.

* Support the maintenance, implementation, and periodic review of established business rules and operational procedures with specialty distribution partners.

* Contribute to development of product and channel specific contract strategies

  
  

**Collaboration with Internal Stakeholders:**

* Coordinate operational activities across the vendor program manager, Access Strategy, Patient Services, Trade & Distribution, Data & Analytics, and field leadership.

* Maintain documented responsibilities and handoffs, and route strategic, policy, and customer-facing decisions to the accountable function. Work cross-functionally with Market Access on product access issues and Medical team on resource development and pull-through.

* Develop relationships and work closely with the Patient Services team and/or Field Reimbursement Managers to help resolve patient/ provider access issues.

* Provide regular updates regarding partner performance, patient access issues, and any operational challenges, continuously evolving/challenging our support model with learnings related to medical/pharmacy benefit coverage learnings

* Collaborate with the team to continuously improve patient services and operational processes, including reviewing and optimizing workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

  
  

**Issue Investigation & Resolution:**

* Take ownership of investigating operational issues and work with internal and external teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

* Address challenges related to patient enrollment, medication distribution, insurance verification, or other issues impacting pharmacy operations.

* Escalate critical issues as needed and ensure effective communication with all relevant parties to resolve problems quickly and efficiently.

  
  

**Reporting & Data Analysis:**

* Identify appropriate metrics and tracking to ensure the right execution and success; analyze procedure volume, trends and growth for the specialty channel.

* Compile operational metrics, document performance trends, and provide reporting support for management reviews and business update meetings. Provide regular reports on operational performance, issue resolution, and process improvements to the Director of Specialty Operations.

* Analyze specialty reporting and work with data and analytics team to create patient, provider, physician, pharmacy and payer data dashboards in order to help improve processes

* Monitor specialty distributor/pharmacy data (ie; Time to First Fill, Conversion Rate, Gap days and Adherence)

  
  

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in regular process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing specialty distribution network operations and enhancing the patient experience.

* Provide input into the development and refinement of training materials, operational procedures, and best practices for working with specialty pharmacy partners.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, including hands-on management of specialty partner operations, patient services, and complex access workflows. Demonstrated experience coordinating hub, specialty pharmacy, and specialty distribution services and managing vendor performance is required.

* Experience with medical benefit therapies, institutional delivery, and launch implementation is preferred.

* Experience evaluating data sources for insights, specifically specialty distribution and patient services data.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* Pharmacy experience preferred

**Qualifications**

* Cloud-based collaboration and enterprise platforms

  
**Additional Information**

* Manual and repetitive processes are reduced through automation and digital workflows.
* Measurable productivity improvements are achieved through technology adoption.
* Data-driven decision-making becomes part of everyday operations.
* The organization develops a sustainable culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* A secure, scalable, and integrated digital ecosystem supports future business growth.

Title: IT Director of Operations
Description:
**Job Summary**
Reporting to the VP of Infrastructure, the IT Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the organization's Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, service request fulfillment, and end-user support functions. This role is accountable for delivering reliable, responsive, secure, and consistent technology support to corporate offices, service centers, remote workers, and operating locations.
  
  
The Director establishes a customer-focused operating model, develops high-performing support teams, improves service quality through standardization and automation, and ensures operational processes produce measurable improvements in user experience, service availability, response time, resolution time, change success, and cost efficiency. The position partners closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Information Security, Enterprise Applications, Clinical Applications, Human Resources, Compliance, Finance, vendors, and business leaders, and serves as a senior leader during major incidents and high-risk changes.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability for Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and related operational support functions, including organizational design, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, succession planning, performance management, and professional development.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year IT operations strategy and service improvement roadmap aligned with business growth, acquisitions, technology modernization, cybersecurity requirements, financial objectives, employee experience, and operational risk tolerance.
* Own the Service Desk operating model, including intake channels, call handling, ticket triage, prioritization, escalation, request fulfillment, knowledge management, shift coverage, quality assurance, customer communications, and service-level performance.
* Lead Field Services and deskside support across distributed locations, including onsite incident resolution, device deployment and recovery, site support, technology readiness for openings and relocations, executive support, inventory coordination, and local vendor management.
* Own IT service management practices and governance, including incident, request, major incident, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, configuration, and continual improvement processes, using ITIL-aligned practices and clearly defined ownership, controls, and measures.
* Lead enterprise Change Control and the Change Advisory Board process. Establish risk and impact criteria, approval thresholds, peer and technical review requirements, testing expectations, implementation and rollback standards, maintenance-window governance, emergency change controls, post-implementation validation, and reporting.
* Serve as the senior operational leader for major technology incidents. Ensure rapid business-impact assessment, clear command and escalation structures, timely stakeholder communications, cross-team coordination, service restoration, executive updates, after-action reviews, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective actions.
* Establish problem management practices that identify recurring incidents and service degradation, prioritize root-cause investigation, assign accountable owners, track known errors and workarounds, and verify that permanent corrective actions reduce repeat demand.
* Build and govern a usable service catalog, supported by defined services, request offerings, ownership, fulfillment workflows, service targets, knowledge articles, and customer-facing expectations.
* Improve employee technology experience through self-service, automation, shift-left support, remote-support tools, standardized knowledge, proactive communications, customer feedback, and reduction of avoidable contacts and repeat incidents.
* Partner with engineering, security, and application teams to establish effective operational handoffs, support readiness, monitoring and alert response, escalation paths, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria before new or changed services enter production.
* Ensure effective joiner, mover, and leaver support in coordination with Human Resources, Identity and Access Management, Security, and business leaders, including equipment, access requests, onboarding readiness, transfers, and timely recovery of company assets.
* Establish asset and endpoint support controls, including device inventory accuracy, stock and depot processes, warranty and repair coordination, refresh planning, secure disposal, loaner equipment, peripheral standards, and accountability for equipment assigned to users and locations.
* Define and report meaningful operational metrics, including contact volume, abandonment rate, speed to answer, first contact resolution, response and resolution attainment, mean time to restore, backlog age, reopen rate, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, change success rate, emergency change rate, incident recurrence, field dispatch performance, and cost per contact.
* Use performance data, customer feedback, quality reviews, trend analysis, and process audits to identify service gaps, prioritize improvements, and hold teams accountable for measurable outcomes rather than activity alone.
* Manage operating budgets, forecasts, staffing models, contracts, licensing, support tools, managed-service providers, hardware support partners, and vendor performance. Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership without creating unacceptable service, security, compliance, or resilience risk.
* Lead operational due diligence and integration for acquisitions, divestitures, new locations, relocations, and major business initiatives, including support discovery, staffing impacts, device and asset planning, service onboarding, cutover support, communications, and stabilization.
* Ensure operational services comply with company policies, contractual requirements, data-protection obligations, records requirements, and healthcare-related security and privacy requirements, including HIPAA where applicable.
* Communicate service performance, customer-impacting risks, staffing needs, process maturity, investment priorities, and improvement progress clearly to technical teams, business leaders, executive leadership, auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned and provide hands-on operational leadership when business-critical conditions require it.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. The employee may be asked to perform other job-related duties consistent with the role.*
**Job Requirements**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Management, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, service desk, field services, or technology operations, including at least five years leading technical teams or managers in a complex, multi-site enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading Service Desk, Field Services, IT service management, change enablement, major incident management, problem management, and service improvement functions.
* Experience establishing service levels, operating procedures, quality controls, staffing models, escalation structures, knowledge management, service catalogs, and performance reporting.
* Experience with enterprise IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, Jira Service Management, BMC Helix, or comparable tools, including workflow, reporting, knowledge, and self-service capabilities.
* Experience managing operating budgets, strategic vendors, managed-service providers, and distributed support delivery. Experience in healthcare, home health, hospice, post-acute care, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting acquisitions, site openings or relocations, large technology deployments, endpoint refreshes, organizational change, and critical-incident response is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, major incident, configuration, and continual improvement practices.
* Strong knowledge of service desk and field support operations, including call and ticket workflows, prioritization, escalation, workforce planning, queue management, remote support, deskside support, asset handling, and customer communications.
* Ability to design and govern mature change controls using business impact, technical complexity, implementation risk, security exposure, validation requirements, rollback readiness, segregation of duties, and approval thresholds.
* Ability to lead major incidents using clear command roles, business-impact assessment, technical workstreams, communication cadences, restoration priorities, and disciplined after-action follow-through.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints, Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, collaboration tools, endpoint security, remote-support technologies, identity and access processes, and common enterprise support dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret service metrics, identify demand and failure patterns, distinguish activity from outcomes, and translate data into staffing, process, automation, and investment decisions.
* Proven ability to improve customer experience while balancing service quality, security, compliance, standardization, speed, cost, and operational risk.
* Strong financial and vendor-management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, contract review, licensing analysis, staffing and sourcing models, and service-level accountability.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate operational performance, business impact, risks, and recommendations in clear business terms.
* Demonstrated commitment to documentation, automation, knowledge-centered support, standardization, continuous improvement, service ownership, customer experience, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to participate in after-hours escalation as needed, support planned maintenance or deployment windows, and travel to company locations based on business needs.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL 4 Managing Professional, HDI Support Center Manager, HDI Support Center Director, Certified Change Management Professional, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or comparable credentials are preferred, not required.

Title: Program Manager - Hardware/NPI
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Eagle Wireless is seeking a Program Manager to own and drive customer programs through a phase-gate hardware development process — from initial engagement and design through EVT, DVT, PVT, qualification, certification, and ramp to mass production. This role requires hands-on experience managing an engineered hardware product (e.g., a cellular/wireless module, networking device, or IoT end device) through phase-gate NPI to manufacturing release, and comfort coordinating across engineering, supply chain, quality, and external manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage customer-facing programs end-to-end: requirements intake, design and engineering coordination, qualification/testing, certification, and transition to volume manufacturing.
* Own program timelines and deliverables, tracking milestones through phase-gate NPI stages (e.g., EVT, DVT, PVT) to mass production, and flagging/resolving risks before they impact schedule.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts, managing expectations and communicating status, risks, and changes clearly and proactively.
* Coordinate cross-functionally with engineering, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing (including contract manufacturing partners) to ensure readiness at each program gate.
* Lead and support phase-gate reviews across the NPI process — including PRD sign-off, design reviews (PDR/CDR), DFM/DFT review, pilot build coordination, and manufacturing readiness assessments.
* Manage BOM, ECO, and documentation control processes in coordination with engineering and supply chain teams.
* Track and help drive regulatory and carrier certification requirements (e.g., FCC, PTCRB, carrier certification) to support program milestones.
* Support manufacturing transfer and cutover activities, including coordination between design/engineering sites and manufacturing partners.
* Prepare and present program status reports, timelines, and risk assessments to internal leadership and customers.
* Identify and drive process improvements within the PMO to improve program predictability and delivery.

**Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in program or project management, including 2+ years specifically managing hardware products through phase-gate NPI (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent).
* Demonstrated experience managing an engineered hardware product — such as a cellular/wireless module, networking device, or IoT end device — through a phase-gate development cycle to manufacturing release, from concept/design through qualification and into volume production.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers or external manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of phase-gate/stage-gate NPI processes (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent), BOM/ECO management, DFx (DFM/DFT/DFA), and manufacturing readiness gates.
* Excellent cross-functional coordination skills, with the ability to work across engineering, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting program status to customers and leadership.
* Proficiency with program/project tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira/Confluence, or similar) and standard office/productivity software.
* Experience in the cellular/IoT module, networking/telecom equipment, automotive electronics, or wireless communications industry.
* Familiarity with regulatory and carrier certification processes
* Experience with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) for BOM, inventory, and production tracking.
* Experience managing programs across multiple manufacturing sites or geographies.

**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**
**Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.**

Title: Agile Program Management - Director - Financial Services
G&E Manager
Description:
**Job Description:**

G&E Sales Manager

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

  

Reports to Director of Alternative Channels

**About Us**
============

At Cable One and our family of brands, we keep our customers and associates connected to what matters most. For our associates, that means a thriving and rewarding career, respect for the communities where they live and work, a focus on health and wellness, an excellent work/life balance, and an open and inclusive workplace.

**Role Overview**
=================

The G&E Sales Manager leads the Government and Education sales function and is accountable for profitable revenue growth across public-sector and education accounts. This position directly manages G&E sales personnel, establishes go-to-market priorities, maintains disciplined forecasting and pipeline management, and coordinates complex opportunities with Sales Engineering, Operations, Legal, Finance, Marketing, E-Rate resources, and other internal stakeholders. The role reports to the Director of Alternative Channels.

**What You Will Do to Contribute to the Company's Success**
===========================================================

**Team Leadership & Development**
---------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop G&E sales personnel, with an emphasis on motivation, accountability, professional development, and consistent performance against goals.

* Establish clear expectations for sales activity, pipeline development, opportunity progression, forecast accuracy, customer engagement, and revenue attainment.

* Conduct regular one-on-ones, pipeline reviews, deal strategy sessions, field coaching, and performance discussions.

* Recruit qualified sales associates and support onboarding, training, goal setting, performance evaluations, recognition, behavior counseling, and corrective action as appropriate.

* Promote a learning-based, accountable organization through clear communication, training, recognition, and team building.

**G&E Market Strategy & Revenue Growth**
----------------------------------------

* Own attainment of G&E sales, revenue, install, and profitability objectives, translating annual targets into account, territory, pipeline, and activity plans.

* Establish and execute go-to-market strategies for K-12, higher education, state and local government, libraries, and other eligible public-sector entities within the company footprint.

* Develop account plans for priority G&E customers and prospects, including funding-cycle, contract-expiration, competitive, retention, and expansion strategies.

* Build executive relationships with superintendents, chief information officers, technology directors, procurement officials, municipal leaders, and other public-sector decision-makers and influencers.

* Collaborate with Marketing and Alternative Channels leadership on campaigns, events, associations, cooperative contracts, and partner strategies that expand market reach.

**Public-Sector Procurement & E-Rate Execution**
------------------------------------------------

* Oversee public-sector procurement activity, including requests for proposal, requests for information, formal bids, cooperative purchasing vehicles, contract renewals, and related compliance requirements.

* Lead internal E-Rate resources to support eligible opportunities, program timelines, documentation, competitive bidding requirements, and implementation handoffs while maintaining appropriate separation of responsibilities.

* Coach the team to align opportunity plans with customer budget cycles, board approvals, funding availability, procurement schedules, and contract requirements.

* Ensure sales activity complies with company policies, applicable procurement rules, ethics requirements, customer commitments, and contract-approval processes.

* Review bid specifications, commercial terms, exceptions, deadlines, and internal dependencies early enough to support a complete and competitive response.

**Complex Solution & Opportunity Management**
---------------------------------------------

* Drive disciplined opportunity management for complex connectivity and managed-service solutions, including dedicated internet access, Ethernet private line, dark fiber and fiber-based services where available, voice and UCaaS, managed network, security, and related solutions.

* Coach sellers through discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, solution development, pricing, proposal strategy, negotiation, approvals, contracting, close planning, and implementation handoff.

* Participate directly in high-value, high-risk, or complex opportunities and executive-level customer discussions.

* Ensure customer requirements, evaluation criteria, risks, customer commitments, internal dependencies, and next steps are documented and actively managed.

* Maintain deal velocity while protecting solution feasibility, customer experience, profitability, revenue quality, and company interests.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
----------------------------------

* Coordinate with Sales Engineering and Operations to validate solution design, serviceability, pricing, construction requirements, implementation timing, and customer expectations before commitment.

* Partner with Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, Billing, Construction, implementation, and support resources to develop complete, supportable, and compliant customer solutions.

* Create effective handoffs and maintain leadership visibility through key implementation milestones, particularly for funded, construction-dependent, or time-sensitive projects.

* Escalate barriers early and align internal stakeholders around clear ownership, decision points, customer commitments, and recovery actions.

* Represent Cable One and its family of brands in relevant community, government, education, and industry organizations.

**Pipeline, Forecasting & Performance Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Maintain strong CRM discipline for accounts, contacts, activities, opportunities, next steps, close dates, contract dates, risks, and forecasts.

* Ensure the team maintains sufficient qualified pipeline to achieve assigned sales, revenue, install, and profitability objectives.

* Conduct regular forecast calls and deal reviews, challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and take corrective action when performance is off plan.

* Analyze pipeline coverage, conversion, sales-cycle progression, forecast movement, funding status, procurement milestones, retention risk, and competitive position to guide decisions.

* Provide timely and accurate forecasts, business updates, performance insights, and recovery plans to the Director of Alternative Channels.

**Operating Planning & Governance**
-----------------------------------

* Create and manage operating plans, forecasts, and expense budgets for the G&E sales function.

* Make fact-based recommendations regarding resources, territory coverage, market priorities, events, associations, partnerships, and investments.

* Use financial and performance data to balance growth, profitability, customer value, resource capacity, and implementation risk.

* Provide the highest standard of quality, commitment, and courtesy in interactions with customers, associates, partners, and industry colleagues.

* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.

* Preferred five or more years of B2B, public-sector, telecommunications, technology, or complex solution sales experience, including two or more years of sales leadership or equivalent team-lead responsibility.

* Demonstrated ability to lead a distributed sales team, coach complex opportunities, manage performance, and deliver against revenue and profitability goals.

* Working knowledge of government and education procurement processes. Familiarity with E-Rate, state and local government purchasing, cooperative contracts, and formal RFP processes is strongly preferred.

* Ability to understand and communicate business and technical concepts related to fiber connectivity, dedicated internet, Ethernet, voice, managed network, security, and cloud-enabling services.

* Strong financial and analytical skills, including forecasting, pipeline analysis, pricing, business-case development, percentages, ratios, and practical sales-performance metrics.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret financial reports, contracts, technical documents, bid specifications, and legal or regulatory requirements and respond effectively to customer and agency inquiries.

* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, coaching, and executive relationship-management skills.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and make timely decisions in a matrixed environment.

* Proficiency with CRM, productivity, presentation, and collaboration tools; disciplined CRM adoption and data accuracy are required.

* Current driver's license, reliable transportation, and a driving record that meets company requirements. Regular travel within the assigned footprint and occasional overnight travel are expected.

* Superior leadership, organization, judgment, and motivational skills, with a professional, self-directed, accountable, and customer-focused approach.

**Core Competencies**
=====================

* **Sales Leadership:** Sets clear direction, coaches effectively, reinforces accountability, and builds a high-performing sales culture.

* **Public-Sector Acumen:** Understands government and education buying processes, funding cycles, formal procurements, and stakeholder environments.

* **Strategic Thinking:** Connects market, account, competitive, funding, and operational insights to executable growth plans.

* **Customer Focus:** Builds trusted relationships and ensures solutions address meaningful business, technical, educational, and community outcomes.

* **Commercial Acumen:** Balances growth, profitability, compliance, solution feasibility, customer value, and company interests.

* **Communication & Influence:** Communicates effectively with customers, agency leaders, executives, sellers, technical teams, and cross-functional partners.

* **Execution & Accountability:** Maintains urgency, clear ownership, reliable follow-through, accurate forecasting, and disciplined sales execution.

* **Collaboration:** Works effectively across Sales, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Finance, Marketing, E-Rate, and implementation stakeholders.

* **Problem-Solving:** Identifies risks and barriers, evaluates options, engages the right resources, and drives timely resolution.

* **Data & Technical Fluency:** Uses CRM data, performance insights, procurement information, and connectivity concepts to guide decisions and improve results.

**Success Measures**
====================

* Achievement of assigned sales, revenue, install, retention, and profitability goals.

* Healthy qualified pipeline coverage and consistent opportunity progression across G&E segments.

* Forecast accuracy, CRM data quality, and timely identification of funding, procurement, competitive, construction, and implementation risks.

* Execution against RFP, E-Rate, cooperative contract, renewal, and customer budget-cycle milestones.

* G&E seller development, productivity, goal attainment, and adherence to sales-process expectations.

* Effective cross-functional execution and smooth transitions from sale through implementation and ongoing customer management.

**Benefits**
============

Cable One and our family of brands appreciate the role our associates play in helping the company grow. We offer an excellent benefits package that recognizes the importance of their contributions, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans - start when you start.

* Life insurance for associates, spouses, and children.

* Paid time off, including vacation, holidays, and personal/sick days.

* 401(k) with 100% company match, up to 5% of eligible compensation, beginning on the first day of service.

* Group Legal plan with Identity Theft Protection.

**Additional Perks**
====================

* Tuition reimbursement, up to $5,250 in the first year.

* Free services for associates who live within a service area.

* Annual community support for organizations across the United States.

* Associate recognition and awards programs.

* Advancement opportunities and a collaborative work environment.

**Our Commitment**
==================

Diversity lies in the communities we serve and among the associates who dedicate themselves to our continued success. At Cable One and our family of brands, we believe our individual talents, backgrounds, and perspectives make us stronger together.

Cable One and our family of brands is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability.

**Pre-Hire Processes**
======================

Cable One and our family of brands is committed to keeping our associates and customers safe. Job offers are contingent upon the results of background screening, drug screening, and reference checks. Title: MNOC West Lead
Description:
The
**Network Operations Center (NOC) Lead**
provides senior operational leadership, technical oversight, and strategic direction for a mission-critical Network/Mission Network Operations Center supporting 24x7 operations. The NOC Lead is responsible for ensuring the
**security, availability, reliability, readiness, and efficient operation**
of network and IT services supporting the MSC fleet.
  
  
This position supervises and directs a multidisciplinary team operating around the clock, establishes operational priorities, monitors compliance with contractual and performance requirements, and coordinates incident response and service restoration. The NOC Lead works closely with government customers, program leadership, technical teams, and the NOC East location to maintain consistent operational standards and ensure mission readiness.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge with proven leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills and will be capable of managing personnel and operations in a high-tempo, mission-critical environment.
  
  
**Location:**
Wahiawa, HI
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Work Arrangement:**
On-Site
  
  
**Security Clearance:**
Active Top Secret Clearance Required
  
  
**Certification:**
DoD IAT Level III or equivalent
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ years IT experience; 3+ years recent leadership/supervisory experience
  
  
**Education:**
High School Diploma or Equivalent
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
**NOC Operations & Mission Readiness**

* Provide overall operational leadership for the NOC and ensure effective 24x7x365 monitoring and support of mission-critical services.
* Supervise and manage a team consisting of nine on-site Watch Operators supporting 24x7 operations and six Subject Matter Experts supporting Monday–Friday operations.
* Establish operational priorities and ensure adequate staffing, coverage, and workload distribution.
* Ensure systems, hardware, configurations, and data flows remain operational, secure, and in a hot-standby/readiness posture to support MSC fleet requirements.
* Monitor operational performance and ensure services are delivered in accordance with established Performance Work Standards (PWS), task requirements, procedures, and contractual obligations.
* Identify operational risks and develop mitigation strategies to maintain service availability and mission continuity.
* Provide after-hours and surge support when required by mission or operational conditions.

**Personnel Leadership & Management**

* Provide day-to-day leadership, direction, and technical guidance to NOC personnel.
* Manage staffing, schedules, workload assignments, and operational coverage.
* Review and approve employee timesheets and ensure accurate reporting of labor and project activities.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide coaching and feedback, and administer formal counseling when appropriate.
* Identify personnel development and training requirements and promote professional growth.
* Foster a professional, collaborative, safety-conscious, and mission-focused work environment.
* Ensure personnel comply with applicable company, government, security, safety, and operational requirements.

**Operational Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct routine and detailed reviews of operational tracking tools to ensure information is current, accurate, complete, and actionable.
* Monitor accomplishment of Performance Work Standards, task lists, operational requirements, and project deliverables.
* Maintain operational documentation, reports, logs, metrics, and records necessary to demonstrate compliance and performance.
* Identify deficiencies, recurring issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Develop and implement corrective actions when operational or performance requirements are not being met.
* Ensure consistent procedures and operational standards are maintained across NOC locations.

**Incident Management & Service Restoration**

* Oversee the response, tracking, escalation, and resolution of incident and trouble-call tickets.
* Ensure incidents are prioritized appropriately based on mission impact and restored as efficiently as possible.
* Coordinate with technical teams, government personnel, and other stakeholders during significant incidents and outages.
* Monitor recurring incidents and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
* Ensure accurate and timely ticket documentation, escalation, resolution, and closure.
* Support root-cause analysis and after-action reviews for significant operational events.

**Cross-Site Coordination & Collaboration**

* Maintain close coordination with NOC East in Pensacola, Florida, ensuring consistent operational practices, procedures, and service delivery.
* Participate in cross-site planning, staffing coordination, technical discussions, and operational reviews.
* Facilitate communication and knowledge sharing between NOC locations and technical teams.
* Support standardization of procedures, reporting, monitoring, and operational processes across sites.
* Coordinate with corporate leadership and program management on organizational initiatives and operational requirements.

**Program & Project Support**

* Perform assigned Project Manager and Operations Manager responsibilities in coordination with the MNOC Lead.
* Serve as a liaison between site personnel, program leadership, corporate management, and government stakeholders.
* Support implementation of corporate directives, program initiatives, process changes, and infrastructure improvements.
* Evaluate operational requirements and submit recommendations or proposals for infrastructure, process, and service improvements.
* Track assigned projects, action items, deliverables, and milestones through completion.
* Provide management with status updates, operational metrics, risks, and recommendations.

**Security & Infrastructure**

* Ensure NOC hardware, configurations, systems, and data flows comply with applicable security policies, technical standards, and established procedures.
* Maintain systems in a secure and operationally ready condition.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity and technical personnel to address vulnerabilities, security concerns, configuration issues, and operational risks.
* Ensure personnel follow applicable security requirements when handling systems, data, equipment, and classified information.
* Support security inspections, assessments, audits, and corrective-action activities as required.

**Facilities, Safety & Logistics**

* Ensure the NOC facility remains safe, secure, orderly, and operationally ready.
* Ensure facility upkeep, cleanliness, and appropriate working conditions.
* Monitor site safety requirements and promptly address safety concerns.
* Ensure adequate supplies, equipment, and materials are available to support operations.
* Submit timely purchase orders and supply requests in accordance with established company procedures.
* Implement and manage the applicable Inclement Weather Plan when required.
* Maintain accountability for personnel safety during normal and emergency operations.

**Reporting & Communication**

* Prepare and submit operational reports, status updates, metrics, and performance information to leadership and government stakeholders as required.
* Communicate significant incidents, operational risks, staffing concerns, and service-impacting conditions promptly.
* Maintain effective communication with personnel across all shifts.
* Conduct or participate in operational meetings, briefings, reviews, and planning sessions.
* Ensure accurate turnover between shifts and effective communication of outstanding issues and priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of IT experience , with at least 3 years of recent leadership or supervisory experience.
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience leading IT, NOC, network operations, systems administration, or mission operations personnel.
* Experience managing teams supporting 24x7x365 operations.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network operations, incident management, and service availability.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-tempo, mission-critical environment.
* Experience with operational tracking, reporting, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with government customers, technical teams, management, and geographically dispersed personnel.
* Ability to provide leadership during outages, emergencies, surge operations, and other high-priority events.
* Ability to travel periodically to corporate headquarters in Virginia and NOC East in Pensacola, Florida.
* Active Top Secret security clearance required.

**Certification Requirements**

* DoD IAT Level III certification or equivalent , in accordance with applicable DoD cybersecurity requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Prior experience supporting Department of Defense or U.S. Navy programs.
* Experience supporting a Network Operations Center, Mission Network Operations Center, Command Center, or similar 24x7 operational environment.
* Experience with DoD network operations, cybersecurity, communications, or enterprise infrastructure.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed or cross-site technical teams.
* Experience with IT service management (ITSM), incident management, and ticketing systems.
* Experience developing operational procedures, performance metrics, SOPs, and process-improvement initiatives.
* Prior military communications, network operations, information technology, or technical leadership experience is highly desirable.

**Work Location & Travel**
This is a
**fully on-site position in Wahiawa, Hawaii**
. This position is
**not remote or hybrid**
, and the selected candidate is expected to report to the facility daily, Monday through Friday, while providing leadership and oversight of 24x7 operations.
  
  
**Some travel may be required**
to the company's headquarters in Virginia and to NOC East in Pensacola, Florida, for meetings, training, operational coordination, or other mission requirements.
  
  
The anticipated salary range for this role is $165,000 to $173,000 annually. The anticipated salary range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. The final starting salary will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, skills, relevant experience, education, certifications, and work location (where applicable), as well as internal equity and market considerations.

Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

The next IT leader will bring innovation and collaboration, working in support of City-wide goals to be a strategic partner in service delivery and smart IT solutions. This is a rare opportunity to serve in a pivotal role in a well-managed, effectively governed, incredibly diverse community with an exceptionally high quality of life.
  
  
As part of the Senior Leadership Team, the Director of Information Technology Services will have the opportunity to lead key City and departmental initiatives, drive operational excellence, and help shape the future of our City in partnership with dedicated department directors, elected officials, and community members. Applicants must have subject matter skills and knowledge, supervisory and management experience, and a track record in leadership working with a diverse workforce and affecting inclusive and effective outcomes. This position truly offers a skilled leader the opportunity to work in partnership with the City Manager and Senior Leadership Team to bring new perspectives, leadership, and additional innovation to further the City's mission, vision, core values, and long-range goals.
  
  
The IT Services Director reports directly to the City Manager. As a member of the City's senior leadership team, the Director collaborates with the City Manager, Assistant City Managers, and other department directors on strategy and policy to ensure that the City's mission, vision, core values, and long-range goals are incorporated into operational activities and services.
  
  
The position can accommodate both in-person and limited remote work at the discretion of the City Manager. Preparation for and attendance at meetings, events, and other work outside of regular business hours is required. Residency within the City of Gaithersburg is not required.
  
  
For more details about the role and the Gaithersburg community, please review the Position Profile [PDF].
  
  
Job Functions
  
  
**The Position**
The IT Services Director performs complex professional work in the planning, organizing, and coordinating of the development, implementation, and maintenance of the City’s electronic data processing, management information systems, and related operations. The Director provides leadership, direction, and advanced professional expertise and oversight to the Department and employees responsible for coordination of the IT services for the City and is responsible for short- and long-range planning of the City’s technical infrastructure to ensure that it supports current and future business needs.
  
  
The complete classification description for the Director of Information Technology Services position can be viewed here.
  
  
**The Department**
The Information Technology Services Department consists of 16.67 FTE, including the Director. The department has four groups, IT Central Support Services, Business Systems and Transformation Services, Network Operations and Security Services, and GIS and Data Services. IT Central Support Services provides City staff with Tier I and Tier II technical support of hardware, software, and systems. Business Systems and Transformation Services is responsible for maintaining business systems throughout their full lifecycle – requirements, procurement, implementation, and ongoing maintenance. Network Operations and Security Services is responsible for network, server, and telecommunication infrastructure as well as physical and cybersecurity, including identity management, emails, files, firewalls, and desktop and server patching. GIS and Data Services is tasked with creating, implementing, and maintaining geographic information data standards and enterprise GIS systems.
  
  
**Duties**
The department has a budget of $3.3 million. In addition to its regular operational duties, some of the Department’s current projects include:
  
  

* Support of the new City Hall construction at 12 South Summit Avenue.
* Implementation of a Rubrik-based backup and disaster recovery system.
* Creation of comprehensive IT policies and procedures.
* Replacement of the City’s phone system.
* Implementation of resilient WAN connections at major facilities.
* Evaluation and implementation of Artificial Intelligence technologies.
* Implementation activities surrounding major Public Works GIS initiatives.
* Selection and implementation of a centralized data warehouse with analytical services and artificial intelligence capabilities.
* Selection and implementation of a Constituent Relationship Management system.
* Implementation of a new HRIS, Payroll and Time and Attendance system.
* Implementation of a comprehensive ITSM/ITAM system.
* Replacement of the meeting management system.
* Supporting the City’s upcoming 2027 elections.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or related field.
* At least 10 years of experience managing information technology systems, the majority of which shall have been in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
* Valid driver's license.

**Desired/Preferred Qualifications**

* Local government experience is desired; municipal government experience is strongly preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification; and/or
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)/Certified Information Security Manager (CISM); and/or
* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Service Management (ITSM) certification; and/or
* Certified Geographic Information System Professional (GISP).

**The Successful Candidate**
The ideal candidate for the Director of Information Technology Services position is a proficient, accomplished and forward-thinking public sector leader who is passionate about transforming local government through technology and is dedicated to public service. This individual is a strategic thinker who can translate big-picture goals into actionable plans, while also possessing the hands-on practical expertise to ensure high-quality service delivery, technological security, and operational effectiveness. The ideal candidate demonstrates intellectual humility and curiosity, values the expertise and institutional knowledge of experienced staff, and fosters meaningful collaboration within the department and across the organization while building strong relationships with elected officials, community members, and regional partners. They will possess the ability to navigate sensitive issues and competing interests with diplomacy, fairness, and discretion.
  
  
An exceptional communicator and listener, the successful candidate understands the value of inclusive engagement, transparency, and trust-building. They are committed to cultivating a positive organizational culture, empowering and developing staff through coaching, recognizing collective accomplishments, and managing performance in a constructive, accountability-oriented manner. This person must be comfortable with ambiguity and change, capable of championing innovation while maintaining reliable IT operations, and skilled in balancing strategic priorities with available resources and long-term operational sustainability. With a solid understanding of information technology operations, public administration, municipal finance, and municipal operations, the ideal Director of Information Technology Services brings both a visionary mindset and an engaged leadership style. They are technically proficient and grounded in values of equity, integrity, and professionalism, and thrive in an evolving, team-oriented environment where collaboration, creativity, and service excellence are expected and rewarded.
