Title: Senior Manager, Joy & Listening Strategy
Description:
Requisition ID # 175774
  
  
**Job Category:** Customer Support / Operations
  
**Job Level:** Senior Manager
  
**Business Unit:** People
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  
Department Summary
  
  
The Enterprise Engagement team helps create the conditions for coworkers to thrive and for teams to perform at their best. We connect coworker insights, culture, inclusion and belonging, and performance practices to strengthen the everyday coworker experience and help the organization deliver on its Purpose, Virtues, and Stands.
  
  
The team leads enterprise strategies and programs that shape and strengthen culture, including Joy at Work, Breakthrough, and Inclusion & Belonging. We use coworker listening, data, and insights to understand the experiences and mindsets influencing culture, identify opportunities for improvement, and help translate those insights into focused action.
  
  
Through enterprise programs, tools, and partnerships, the team helps leaders and teams strengthen connection, belonging, ownership, and performance; embed desired ways of working into the everyday coworker experience, and build the capabilities needed to turn culture into a driver of business outcomes.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Manager, Joy & Listening Strategy is responsible for leading PG&E’s enterprise Joy at Work listening, measurement, and improvement strategy to advance the coworker experience and drive achievement of the enterprise Joy at Work L1 metric. This role oversees the collection, analysis, and translation of coworker feedback into actionable insights, strategic priorities, and measurable improvements, with a particular focus on frontline coworkers and organizations with the greatest opportunity for improvement.
  
  
The Senior Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight of enterprise listening programs, including but not limited to Joy at Work surveys, Joy Pulse and Joy Daily, ensuring a coordinated approach to measuring coworker sentiment, identifying key performance drivers, and evaluating the effectiveness of improvement actions. This role leads a team of analysts and program professionals and partners with functional area leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen accountability, accelerate improvement and embed data-informed decision-making into enterprise operating rhythms.
  
  
The role is hybrid working from your remote office and in-person at Oakland General Office, 1-2x weekly based on business needs.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
Lead the development and execution of PG&E’s enterprise Joy at Work listening and measurement strategy, establishing priorities, performance expectations and improvement opportunities that drive achievement of the enterprise L1 Joy at Work metric. Partner with functional areas to identify performance gaps, evaluate improvement plans, and accelerate progress toward enterprise targets. Oversee the enterprise listening ecosystem, including Joy at Work surveys, Joy Pulse, Joy Daily and other feedback mechanisms. Establish consistent approaches to collecting, analyzing, and interpreting coworker sentiment, ensuring insights are timely, actionable, and connected to enterprise priorities. Develop targeted listening and measurement strategies that elevate frontline coworker perspectives, address participation and accessibility barriers, and identify opportunities to improve the frontline experience. Partner with operational leaders to translate frontline insights into prioritized improvement actions and measurable outcomes. Direct the analysis of Joy performance drivers, sentiment trends, and coworker feedback to inform enterprise priorities and leadership decisions. Establish consistent methods to evaluate the effectiveness of functional area Joy improvement plans, recommend adjustments, and strengthen the connection between listening, action, and results. Lead the integration of Joy insights and performance measures into enterprise operating rhythms, including Joy Councils, monthly operating reviews, leadership forums, and structured problem-solving. Establish clear performance expectations, escalation processes, and follow-up mechanisms to drive accountability and continuous improvement. Lead, coach, and develop a team of analysts and program professionals responsible for survey execution, data analytics, strategic insights, and program delivery. Partner with enterprise leaders, functional areas, and cross-functional teams to align priorities, strengthen execution and deliver measurable improvements in the coworker experience. Oversee complex and unique strategic planning projects and initiatives that are of highest visibility and impact. Create and implement long-term research and analytical strategies, ensuring effective execution to apply insights across product, marketing, customer, and integration strategies on a daily basis. Act as an advocate for coworkers to all areas of the Company. Lead identification of new and existing technologies and processes. Develop and manage budgets, across multiple funding sources and identify innovations and cost-reduction potential of new and existing technologies and processes and implement contract management process improvement.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Statistics, or equivalent experience. 6 years of experience in utilities, retail, financial services, consumer products, or telecommunications including supervisory/managerial experience. 4 years’ experience in customer strategy work in the utility, financial services, telecommunications, or consumer products sectors.
  
  
**Desired Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  
Strong experience in implementing and using customer qualitative/quantitative research methods, tools, and applications of statistical analysis. Proven track record in defining strategic objectives and setting metrics and performance measures. Experience in successfully managing vendor relationships. Experience developing and implementing customer experience tools, i.e., journey maps, service blueprints, etc. Experience applying Lean methodology. Knowledge of concepts, best practices, tools, techniques, and strategies related to conducting behavioral analysis as needed to perform at the job level. Ability to read and understand information and ideas presented through written words and sentences as need to perform at the job level. Competency in developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. Ability to create graphics, maps, schematics, or diagrams to present information as needed to perform at the job level. Competency in making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Competency in adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations. Competency in building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Knowledge of concepts, best practices, tools, techniques, and strategies related to intelligence data gathering, analysis, and decision-making as needed to perform at the job level.
  
  
Compensation
  
  
PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.
  
**Bay Area Min:** $151,000 Bay Area Mid: $204,000 Bay Area Max: $257,000

Title: Program Manager
Description:
Overview:

The **Program Manager** serves as the senior on-site contract leader responsible for the overall management, performance, and integrated delivery of Facility Support Services III requirements supporting the Arnold Engineering Development Complex mission. This position is dedicated to the contract, is located at Arnold Air Force Base, and is empowered to make and implement decisions regarding contract performance. The Program Manager is the principal management interface with Government representatives and provides leadership across Security Services, Operational Command and Control, Fire and Emergency Services, Environmental, Safety, Quality, and general contract-management functions.

***\*\* This position is contingent upon contract award \*\****

Responsibilities:

* Provide overall leadership and management of contract performance and serve as the principal management interface with the Contracting Officer, Contracting Officer Representative, and other Government stakeholders.
* Direct the integrated execution of Security Services, Operational Command and Control, Fire and Emergency Services, Environmental, Safety, Quality, and general contract-management requirements.
* Ensure contract resources, staffing, schedules, deliverables, Government-furnished resources, and financial performance are efficiently and effectively managed.
* Maintain a qualified workforce capable of supporting routine, 24/7, surge, emergency, contingency, disaster, and mission-essential service requirements.
* Monitor contract performance against cost, schedule, quality, staffing, safety, security, compliance, and customer-service requirements; identify risks and implement timely mitigation strategies.
* Oversee subcontractors and coordinate activities with associate contractors to support successful integration with AEDC mission operations.
* Ensure required plans, reports, records, staffing data, and Contract Data Requirements List deliverables are accurate, complete, and submitted on time.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the contract Quality Management System, including root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, trend analysis, and effectiveness verification.
* Plan, prepare, and present the monthly Executive Program and Quality Review report and briefing covering each functional area, CDRL status, inspection results, problem resolution, and overall program trends.
* Lead or support Government meetings, inspections, exercises, audits, program reviews, emergency-management activities, and executive-level briefings.
* Oversee continuity of operations, transition, phase-in, and phase-out activities while minimizing interruptions or delays to mission support.
* Coordinate supplemental-work requests, proposals, and required authorizations with the Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer Representative before work exceeds authorized limits.
* Promote professional and ethical conduct, strong customer relationships, safe work practices, regulatory compliance, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Provide direct supervision and performance management for assigned managers and functional leaders.
* Other duties as assigned

  
Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, engineering, public administration, or a related discipline. A combination of relevant education and directly related experience may be considered.
* Minimum of ten years of progressively responsible program or operations management experience, including experience managing a large, complex federal or Department of Defense service contract.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing multidisciplinary operations such as security, emergency response, command and control, environmental, safety, facilities, or base-support services.
* Demonstrated experience managing staffing, subcontractors, schedules, contract deliverables, customer relationships, risk, quality, and regulatory compliance.
* Working knowledge of federal contracting, Government contract administration, performance-based service requirements, and contractor relationships with Government personnel.
* Demonstrated ability to manage mission-critical services operating on a 24/7 basis and to support surge, emergency, contingency, and continuity requirements.
* Experience managing performance metrics, audits, inspections, root-cause analyses, corrective actions, and formal quality-management programs.
* Experience preparing and delivering program reviews, executive briefings, reports, and written correspondence for senior Government and contractor leadership.
* Ability to obtain and maintain Arnold Air Force Base installation access, required system access, and any security eligibility applicable to assigned duties.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel as required.
* Successfully pass background and drug screening

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Master’s degree in business administration, management, engineering, public administration, or related discipline.
* Minimum of four (4) years of experience serving as a Director of Emergency Services, or equivalent leadership role, for the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, or U.S. Marine Corps on a military installation.
* Program Management Professional (PMP), Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act credential, Lean Six Sigma, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, or comparable program/quality credential.
* Experience managing Department of the Air Force or Air Force Materiel Command base-operating-support services.
* Experience at an aerospace, test, industrial, installation-support, or other high-hazard mission environment.
* Experience with Contract Data Requirements Lists, Government-furnished property, associate contractor agreements, transition planning, and supplemental-work authorization processes.

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*

* Advanced knowledge of federal contract management, performance-based service delivery, subcontractor management, and Government customer relations.
* Knowledge of quality-management principles, performance measurement, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, risk management, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to integrate multiple technical and operational functions into a coordinated program that meets cost, schedule, quality, safety, security, and mission requirements.
* Ability to lead managers and multidisciplinary teams in routine and high-pressure operational environments.
* Ability to interpret contract requirements, policies, regulations, technical directives, and performance standards and translate them into executable plans and measurable outcomes.
* Strong judgment, decision-making, negotiation, conflict-resolution, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior Government and corporate leadership.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaborative business systems used for program management, reporting, scheduling, records, and performance tracking.
* Ability to safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information, proprietary information, and other sensitive data in accordance with contract and company requirements.

*Physical Demands:* (The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)

* Sufficient fine motor skill for use of computers, calculator with an ability to withstand repetitive keyboarding for extended periods of time
* Visual, auditory and communication abilities sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job
* Ability to kneel bend and twist at the waist on an occasional basis,
* Ability to push, pull, carry and lift objects weighing up to 20 pounds on a regular basis and more on an occasional basis
* Ability to travel by plane and safely operate a motor vehicle
* Ability to respond to operational needs outside normal business hours when required.

Title: Associate Director, Portfolio Operations Excellence
Description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, National Portfolio Field Excellence, the Associate Director, National Portfolio Field Excellence leads the team responsible for Revolution Medicines’ U.S. commercial regional congress, sponsorship, peer-to-peer speaker program, and speaker contracting operations across the portfolio. This leader drives the operating model that underpins these programs- intake, governance, vendor management, budget stewardship, and compliance- enabling brand and field teams to execute with speed, consistency, and confidence in preparation for anticipated launches and in line brands.

This is a portfolio-level position rather than an asset-specific one. It requires a leader who combines people management with hands-on operational and field sales expertise: directing day-to-day execution, building scalable processes in advance of launch demand, and serving as the organization’s subject matter expert on operations supporting regional congresses and peer-to-peer education.

The role also supports planning and execution of national, area, and regional field meetings, including launch and plan-of-action meetings. This includes coordinating timelines, logistics, vendors, budgets, and follow-through, and supporting portfolio-level connectivity across field teams.

The Associate Director serves as a strategic and operational partner to Marketing, Sales Leadership, Medical Affairs, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, Finance, Accounts Payable, IT, and external agencies, establishing consistent ways of working and advancing continuous improvement across the U.S. National Portfolio Field Excellence organization.

This is a non-demand-generating leadership role: it carries no sales quota and conducts no promotional activity with customers.

Key responsibilities include:

* Lead, coach, and develop the program and operations team, setting priorities, service expectations, and accountability for execution.
* Lead U.S. promotional speaker bureau operations across portfolio brands, including speaker nomination, vetting, fair market value review coordination, contracting, onboarding, training logistics, recertification, and utilization monitoring.
* Manage speaker program systems and vendors, including field requests, approval workflows, attendee records, honoraria and expense payments, program closeout, and data readiness for Open Payments reporting.
* Plan and execute commercial regional congresses and sponsorships with Marketing, Sales Leadership, and Medical Affairs, including annual calendars, engagement plans, exhibits, field staffing, logistics, on-site operations, and follow-up.
* Manage national, area, and regional field meetings, including launch and plan-of-action meetings; coordinate timelines, logistics, and follow-through.
* Coordinate forums and activities that strengthen portfolio connectivity across field teams in support of shared customers, launches, and evolving commercial priorities.
* Own agency and supplier performance, scopes of work, program budgets, forecasts, accruals, reconciliation, and financial closeout in partnership with Procurement and Finance.
* Establish consistent processes for program intake, approvals, contracting, purchase orders, payments, and documentation; partner with Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance to maintain appropriate controls and practical guidance.
* Partner with Sales Operations & Analytics and IT on systems, workflows, data quality, and reporting; use program results and stakeholder feedback to resolve issues and improve execution.
* Support launch readiness and continuous improvement by building scalable processes, vendor capacity, job aids, and stakeholder training aligned with portfolio priorities.
* Travel approximately 25% for regional congresses, speaker training events, commercial meetings, and home office collaboration.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree required with at least 8 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology sales, commercial operations, including speaker bureau and congress or event operations in partnership with brand marketing.
* Experience leading and developing program or operations professionals, with clear accountability for team priorities, execution, and performance.
* Experience managing agencies and suppliers, including RFPs, scopes of work, budgets, forecasting, accruals, and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of speaker program and event management systems, or speaker bureau vendor platforms, and related CRM workflows and data flows.
* Strong understanding of U.S. pharmaceutical requirements and company controls governing promotional programs, HCP engagement, and commercial sponsorships.
* Demonstrated ability to improve cross-functional processes from design through implementation, stakeholder adoption, and measurement of results.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and use operational data to recommend action.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional partners and translate complex requirements into practical guidance.
* Collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable building processes and managing ambiguity in a growing commercial organization.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Oncology experience, including product launch or portfolio expansion.
* Experience planning and executing national, area, or regional sales meetings, including launch or plan-of-action meetings.
* Experience building commercial program processes and infrastructure from pre-launch through launch in a smaller, growing biotechnology company.
* Experience transitioning speaker bureau or congress operations between externally supported and internally managed models.
* Advanced degree or relevant process improvement or meeting management certification, such as Lean Six Sigma or Certified Meeting Professional (CMP).

Title: Senior Operations Manager
Description:
The Senior Operations Manager plays a pivotal role in overseeing and optimizing all aspects of the distribution and warehousing operations within the facility. This key leadership position requires a highly experienced professional with a deep understanding of supply chain management, logistics, and warehouse operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Strategic Planning
  + Develop and implement strategic plans and initiatives to enhance the overall efficiency, productivity, and profitability of the distribution and warehousing operations.
  + Collaborate with senior management to align operational goals with the company's overall objectives.
* Customer Liaison
  + Collaborate with other internal departments, such as sales, marketing, and finance to share customer insights and contribute to the improvement of products and services.
  + Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers by being their primary point of contact. Establish trust and credibility with clients, understanding their needs and expectations.
  + Address customer inquiries, concerns, and complaints in a timely and professional manner. Act as an advocate for the customer within the company, ensuring that their issues are resolved promptly and to their satisfaction.
* Facilities Maintenance
  + Work with security vender to develop, implement and safeguard warehouse operations to enforce safety and security protocols
  + Oversees maintenance and repairs with vendors, reviewing quotes/proposals, to complete time sensitive projects
* Process Optimization
  + Analyze existing processes and identify opportunities for improvement, automation, and cost-saving measures.
  + Design and implement streamlined processes to enhance the flow of goods from receipt to shipping, minimizing processing times and ensuring optimal utilization of resources.
  + Continuous management of storage devices per customer needs to ensure maximum efficiency in the picking and put away processes.
* Inventory Management
  + Oversee inventory control procedures, ensuring accurate and timely tracking of stock levels, reconciling discrepancies, and minimizing shrinkage.
  + Develop inventory strategies to optimize stock levels while meeting customer demand.
* Team Leadership
  + Manage and lead a team of managers, supervisors, warehouse staff, and other operational personnel.
  + Provide guidance, support, and mentorship to foster a high-performance culture, motivating employees to achieve operational excellence.
* Compliance and Safety
  + Ensure compliance with all relevant industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
  + Work collaboratively with HR to Implement and maintain safety programs to minimize accidents and create a safe work environment for all staff.
* Vendor and Supplier Management
  + Collaborate with procurement teams to establish strong relationships with vendors and suppliers.
  + Collaborate with finance to negotiate contracts and terms to ensure cost-effective procurement of goods and services.
* Performance Monitoring
  + Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the performance of the distribution and warehousing operations.
  + Implement corrective actions as needed to meet or exceed performance targets.
  + Communicate and plan coverage for leadership absences.
* Warehouse Optimization
  + Collaborate with solutions to stay informed of emerging technologies and implement relevant tools, software, and systems to optimize warehouse management, order processing, and inventory tracking.
* Budget Management
  + Responsible for budget preparation and adherence.
  + Monitor expenses, identify cost-saving opportunities, and maintain financial discipline in the operations department.
* Continuous Improvement
  + Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging employees to provide feedback, suggest innovative solutions, and participate in process improvement initiatives.

The duties and responsibilities described above may provide only a partial description of this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all aspects of the job. Other duties and responsibilities not outlined in this document may be added as necessary or desirable, with or without notice.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Advanced knowledge of production machinery and job-related service delivery equipment and processes are required
* Experience with process flow design and implementation
* Experience with proper documentation for process flows, building layouts, projects management, procurement ROI to obtain executive approval
* Six Sigma certification preferred
* Strong excellent verbal and written communications skills, proven ability to work and communicate with all levels of the organization
* Ability to conduct presentations, facilitate meetings, training
* Possess excellent organizational and time management skills
* Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Ability to manage several complex projects simultaneously while working under pressure to meet timely deadlines
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment with a positive attitude to promote a great working environment
* Work with all departments to create a safe and healthy work environment
* Must be flexible with work schedule when needed
* Bilingual Spanish preferred

**Equipment Knowledge:**

* Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word and PowerPoint)
* Knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally, requires minimum of seven (7+) years’ experience in warehouse operations, manufacturing, or distribution environment. Minimum three (5) years of supervisory experience.

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management or related field preferred or a combination of education and equivalent work experience.

**Judgment/Reasoning Ability:** Able to identify, troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly using sound judgment, poise and diplomacy. Ability to use judgment and reasoning skills, and determine when to escalate issues, as required, in a timely manner.

**Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, climb stairs, use hands and fingers, bend, stoop and reach with hands and arms. **Summary**
The Director of IT Operations leads the IT Service Desk and Field Services teams at Onvida Health, ensuring exceptional delivery of technology support and end-user services. This role oversees the adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow platform while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and alignment with organizational needs. The Director leads IT Service Desk and Field Services operations across all Onvida Health locations, manages ServiceNow platform modules such as Incident, Request, Change, and Asset Management, develops and enforces IT support standards and escalation procedures, and drives continuous improvement and modernization initiatives. The role includes mentoring a high-performing team, managing vendor relationships for support tools and technologies, collaborating with clinical and business leaders to align IT services with broader goals, and serving as a key incident response leader during major service disruptions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Planning/Vision; Competency: a) Provides vision, forward thinking and strategic planning in a proactive manner while being open-minded and creative in establishing a strategic direction. b) Develops through an integration of ideas of those involved, an organized strategy to achieve both short and long term objectives for the department. Effectively communicates strategy to obtain commitment by the responsible individuals. Accountability: Leads the strategic planning process for the respective department. As plans are developed, these plans and objectives are integrated within the plans of the medical center. The incumbent works with others in leadership as well as physicians to identify and evaluate programs and emerging technologies. Leads the strategic planning process for IT Service Delivery, incorporating innovative ideas to enhance service quality and user satisfaction. Aligns the service delivery roadmap with Onvida Health’s broader strategic initiatives and emerging technologies like ServiceNow expansions.
  
  
Fiscal Management :Competency: a) Demonstrates a personal accountability for financial results through development of an annual budget and operational plan and management of performance based on plan. b) Engages staff in efforts to contain costs and improve the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of services. Understands the basics of health care financial management. Accountability: Establishes budget targets for department, provides oversight for the process, and holds self and other individuals accountable for compliance with annual budget plan. Develops and manages the operational budget for Service Desk and Field Services. Monitors expenses, optimizes resource utilization, and evaluates cost-saving measures including ServiceNow automation opportunities and vendor management. Identifies program or service growth opportunities and methodologies to enhance revenues. Able to manage a volume adjusted budget.
  
  
Customer Service; Competency: a) Exhibits unyielding commitment to providing excellent service to patients, physicians, employees and other customers. b) Demonstrates strong communication skills through effective exchange of information with others, including written and oral communication, active listening, influencing the behavior of others and building personal rapport. c) Communicates with others in an open and friendly manner, while simultaneously building credibility and rapport. d) Exhibits strong interactive skills through a demonstration of respecting others’ feelings, ideas and opinions; fosters an open interchange, displays a genuine understanding and acceptance of others. Demonstrates perceptivity regarding others’ feelings, ideas and opinions. Accountability: Responsible for assuring a respectful work environment. Promotes Patient & Family Centered Care. Sets the tone in the department by communicating values and attitudes that will significantly shape the culture of the group. Models appropriate behaviors and values; sets expectations for respectful behavior with all employees. Supports collaboration between patients, families, health care practitioners, and health care leaders in policy and program development, implementation, and evaluation; in facility design; professional education, and delivery of care. Sets a high standard for user experience by embedding a culture of exceptional customer service throughout Service Desk and Field Services teams. Leads initiatives that support Patient & Family Centered Care through technology reliability and responsiveness.
  
  
Operational Management / Quality in Everything We Do ;Competency: a) Exhibits a commitment to operational management and completing tasks through personal initiative, persistence. Demonstrates an ability to plan, organize, coordinate, prioritize, balance workload and follow through to achieve institutional and individual goals and objectives. b) Demonstrates use of good judgments and sound decision making (common sense, intuition, data collection, analytical skills, impact evaluation, communications) to systematically address problems, define alternate solutions, negotiate and facilitate implementation of solutions. c) Able to balance need for consensus and involvement with need for decisiveness and action. Provides consistent and open encouragement to trying new and creative approaches, yet willing to make a decision and take a stand. Contributes new ideas and new ways of thinking to improve departmental performance and services. Identifies need for change and develops/accepts creative approaches and solutions. Participates in performance improvement activities, and by challenging processes, eliminates inefficient/ineffective procedures and waste by collaborating with co-workers or across departments to improve processes. Implements an effective and on-going program to monitor, evaluate and improve the quality of services delivered. Accountability: With the assistance of direct reports, develops processes and procedures which are effective, efficient and aligned with organizational goals and values. Responsible for coordinating and integrating intra-hospital services. Ensures division has qualified staff and needed resources in order to deliver safe quality care and outcomes. Establishes performance standards with which to measure effectiveness and efficiency of services. Drives the establishment of performance metrics, service benchmarks, and quality assurance initiatives within IT Service Delivery. Implements continuous service improvement processes based on user feedback, data analytics, and ServiceNow reporting
  
  
System Thinking ;Competency: a) Ability to see how individual actions contribute to the overall good of the institution. Understands and is able to communicate how individual and department goals overlap with YRMC’s goals. b) Demonstrates commitment for the good of the organization while maintaining congruence with commitment to the department. c) Able to recognize and use information about organizational climate and key individuals to accomplish legitimate organizational goals. d) Aware of the importance of timing, politics and group processes in managing change. e) Able to balance department needs with the hospital needs. Skillful at reconciling the two without sacrificing the critical needs of either. Accountability: Works collaboratively with a variety of key stakeholders to achieve team, department and YRMC’s goals. Demonstrates an ability to align departmental goals with the larger vision of Onvida Health. Understands how IT Service Delivery operations impact clinical, operational, and administrative workflows across the organization.
  
  
Human Resources Management Competency: a) Able to develop others through setting clear expectations, mentoring and coaching, and holding others accountable for results. b) Utilizing work force analysis, identifies required competencies needed for effective management of human resources and is able to identify short and long-term staffing needs, c) Conducts oneself in an honest, credible, trustworthy manner consistent with YRMC’s values. Demonstrates an integration of values, beliefs, attitudes and behaviors through an acceptance of responsibility and accountability for individual’s own actions.
  
  
Accountability: Ensures that the work force has the necessary skills to accomplish the work required to achieve the objectives of the department. Partners with Human Resources to develop long-term human resource plans, anticipating future needs and developing employees able to meet those challenges. Fosters an open working environment for easy access to express ideas and concerns. Demonstrates and expects open communications. Promotes an environment that is open and collaborative while keeping the team focused on a common goal. Builds rapport, encourages teamwork, creates an environment where employees may feel empowered. Leads workforce development efforts by mentoring, coaching, and providing clear career progression pathways for Service Desk and Field Services staff. Partners with HR to forecast staffing needs based on service demands and future technologies.
  
  
Community ;Competency: a) Leverage the unique system capabilities (hospital and community providers) to increase value for external and internal customers and eliminate barriers to care. b) Participate in community involvement. c) Champion community involvement in the department and throughout the organization. Accountability: Promote and encourage community involvement throughout the department. Incorporate community goals in overall departmental goals. Description:
**About the Blank Family of Businesses:**

Arthur Blank is the Chairman and Owner of the Blank Family of Businesses and Co-Founder of The Home Depot, the world’s largest home improvement retailer and second largest retailer in the United States. Arthur’s family of businesses portfolio includes The Arthur M. Blank Family Foundation, National Football League’s Atlanta Falcons, Mercedes-Benz Stadium, PGA TOUR Superstore, Major League Soccer’s Atlanta United FC, and AMB West. While diverse in nature with unique operations and customers, all of these businesses are run based on a common set of core values, which focus on developing customer relationships, treating Associates with respect and supporting communities.

**About AMB West:**

We believe that Montana’s unique ability to connect people to each other and to nature has the power to build stronger, healthier, happier communities, and that we have a role in preserving Montana’s beauty for future generations. Like all the businesses within the Blank Family of Businesses, AMB West is a highly purpose-driven organization devoted to positively impacting the lives of its guests. AMB West consists of Mountain Sky Guest Ranch, West Creek Ranch, Paradise Valley Ranch, and Auster at Dome Mountain. In addition to these exceptional properties, there are additional plans for continued growth which will exponentially increase the positive impact on the Paradise Valley region.

**Auster at Dome Mountain**: Auster at Dome Mountain is the newest project from the AMB West team — a hospitality venture coming to life in the heart of the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem. This property with riverfront acreage will be open to the public and operational year-round. Currently in development, the project will include 20 cabins, a restaurant and bar, a small coffee shop, and a seasonal outdoor pool. With opportunities for outdoor education, recreation, wildlife watching, and winter exploration, the ranch is designed to offer all guests an immersive experience whether they are stopping by for lunch or staying for a week.

**Who we are:**

We use our core values as a compass to guide our decisions because they are our North Star. If we live our core values daily, we know everything else will take care of itself. We enjoy a culture rooted in giving back to others through our time, talents, labor, and financial commitment. We are successful when we collaborate with and value each other like family, maintain a hunger to delight guests and continuously innovate, listen closely for even the smallest need for improvement, stand up for convictions, and genuinely own our responsibilities.

**Our Ideal Candidates:**

Actively Listen – Take an active role in listening by being present in the moment, using healthy body language, and ensuring joint understanding. When we read between the lines and hear what others are saying and what they are not saying, we encounter amazing opportunities to go the extra mile in serving them.

Collaborate – Realize that we are better together than we are alone. We achieve much better results when others have the opportunity to add their diverse perspectives. Be open to feedback and actively seek input from a variety of people at varying levels because the best ideas come from those who are closest to those we serve.

Engage in Servant Leadership – Put others ahead of yourself even when it’s difficult. Find opportunities to lead by example in the way you pitch in and help others. Giving back to others is at the heart of what we do.

Build Relationships – Cultivate trust in relationships by showing respect and sensitivity. Invest time in helping others to continuously improve by listening to their ideas and helping them to continuously improve.

Own Results – Own issues you encounter even when they are outside of your area of responsibility by taking action or seeking out the needed resolution. You are empowered and expected to take risks aimed at exceeding the expectations of our guests. Take advantage of this rare opportunity by utilizing available resources.

**Position Summary**

Auster at Dome Mountain is seeking a hands-on, service-driven Guest Operations Manager to lead daily guest operations across the property. This role coordinates front office, activities, housekeeping, retail, and facilities to deliver a consistent and thoughtful guest experience. The Guest Operations Manager works closely with the General Manager and department managers, remains visible in the operation, and helps teams respond quickly and effectively to guest and business needs.

This is an operational leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between planning, team support, guest interaction, and real-time problem-solving. The ideal candidate brings strong hospitality judgment, clear communication, sound organization, and a willingness to work alongside the team when needed.

**General Responsibilities**

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Support property leadership in the management of daily operations at Auster at Dome Mountain.
* Coordinate guest-facing operations across lodging, front office, guest services, activities, housekeeping, and shared public spaces.
* Maintain a visible leadership presence and help ensure teams are prepared for arrivals, departures, activities, special events, and changing guest needs.
* Serve scheduled Manager on Duty shifts, providing property-wide leadership, supporting guest needs, coordinating operational response, and escalating issues when appropriate.
* Promote consistent service standards and ensure guest concerns are addressed promptly, thoughtfully, and to resolution.
* Lead from the front by supporting departments during high-volume periods and working alongside associates when operational needs require it.
* Facilitate clear communication between departments, including daily priorities, guest preferences, operational adjustments, and follow-up items.
* Support schedules and staffing plans to align coverage with occupancy, service demands, and property events.
* Provide accurate scheduling and time-away information for payroll processing, including sick time, unpaid time, vacation, and other approved leave.
* Participate in operational meetings and communicate decisions, expectations, and action items to the appropriate teams.
* Live out the Blank Family of Businesses core values: Listen & Respond, Include Everyone, Put People First, Give Back to Others, Lead by Example, and Innovate Continuously.

**Guest Experience**

* Review daily guest information and coordinate with teams to anticipate preferences, special occasions, accessibility needs, and service opportunities.
* Serve as a point of escalation for guest concerns and partner with department leaders to identify appropriate solutions.
* Engage with guests throughout the property and gather feedback that can be used to improve service and operations.
* Support guest programming, property events, and other experiences as needed.

**Team Leadership**

* Coach, support, and hold teams accountable to service, conduct, safety, and operational expectations.
* Partner with department managers to establish daily priorities and follow through on commitments.
* Create an environment where associates have the information, tools, and support needed to perform their work effectively.
* Provide timely feedback, recognize strong performance, and address concerns in partnership with property leadership and Human Resources.
* Support onboarding and training so associates understand the property, service expectations, emergency procedures, and their role in the overall guest experience.
* Promote teamwork and respectful communication across departments.

**Operational Planning and Administration**

* Support the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, checklists, logs, and communication tools.
* Monitor operational supplies, equipment, and service needs and coordinate follow-up with the appropriate department or vendor.
* Assist with purchasing and vendor relationships within assigned areas while exercising fiscal responsibility and protecting the guest experience.
* Use guest feedback, operating data, and team observations to identify trends and recommend practical improvements.
* Complete reports, documentation, and follow-up items accurately and on time.
* Protect the privacy of guests, associates, and ownership.

**Safety and Risk Management**

* Partner with property leadership to maintain a safe environment for guests and associates.
* Serve as a capable on-site leader during emergencies by assessing the situation, communicating clearly, and supporting execution of the appropriate response.
* Ensure accidents, incidents, and workers’ compensation first reports are completed and routed promptly.
* Help ensure operational teams follow established safety, security, emergency, and incident-reporting procedures.
* Identify hazards or operational risks and coordinate timely corrective action.

**Recruiting, Onboarding, and Staffing Support**

* Partner with Human Resources and department leaders on workforce planning and recruitment for guest operations roles.
* Support candidate screening and interviews as requested.
* Assist with associate onboarding, orientation, and seasonal or year-round training plans.
* Help maintain clear job descriptions, training materials, and operating expectations for assigned teams.

**Qualifications**

* Prior leadership experience in luxury hospitality, lodging, resort, ranch, club, or a comparable guest-service environment.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple departments and priorities in a fast-moving operation.
* Strong judgment, organization, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to remain calm, practical, and solutions-focused in stressful or time-sensitive situations.
* Proven ability to coach teams, reinforce standards, and build productive working relationships.
* Comfort using standard business, scheduling, point-of-sale, and property-management technology.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to meet company driving requirements.
* Ability and willingness to work a flexible schedule based on operational needs, including nights, weekends, holidays, early mornings, and Manager on Duty shifts.

**Physical and Work Requirements**

* Ability to move throughout indoor and outdoor areas of the property for extended periods.
* Ability to work in varying weather conditions and on uneven terrain.
* Ability to stand or walk for extended periods and perform administrative work while seated as needed.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.

Title: Director, Project Management
Description:
Everest Clinical Research (“Everest”) is a full-service contract research organization (CRO) providing a broad range of expertise-based clinical research services to worldwide pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries. We serve some of the best-known companies and work with many of the most advanced drugs, biologics, and medical devices in development today.

Everest has been an independent CRO since 2004 with a strong foundation as a statistical and data management center of excellence. Building on this foundation, Everest has successfully developed and established itself as a full-service CRO. Everest’s Corporate headquarters are located in Ontario, Canada and US headquarters in New Jersey, USA, with additional physical offices in Asia and Europe.

Everest is known in the industry for its high-quality deliverables, superior customer service, and flexibility in meeting clients’ needs. A dynamic organization with an entrepreneurial origin, Everest continues to experience exceptional growth and great success.

Quality is our backbone, customer-focus is our tradition, flexibility is our strength…that’s us…that’s Everest.

To drive continued success in this exciting clinical research field, we are seeking a committed, skilled, and customer-focused individual to join our winning team as a **Director, Project Management** for our Toronto/Markham, Ontario, Canada on-site location, or remotely from a home-based office anywhere in Canada in accordance with our Work from Home policy.

**Director, Project Management:**

This leadership role will oversee the project planning, communication, and execution of clinical research and development services offered by Everest. Direct reports include all levels and roles within the Project Management department, including Associate Directors, Senior Managers, Managers, Senior Project Managers, Project Managers, Associate Project Managers and Project Coordinators. In-direct reports/subordinates are those Project Managers who are assigned to the tasks on the client studies and projects overseen by the Director of Project Management (matrixed organization).

**JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* Plan and implement new client service delivery requests within client portfolio; support evolution of existing client portfolio, providing holistic biometrics and full services (including clinical operations) project deliveries across multiple clinical development programs.
* Strategically align the efforts of functional area directors and managers in project planning, identification of tasks and deliverables, and assessment of resource needs and utilization for existing and new clients/sponsors.
* Perform project and portfolio performance tracking for responsible projects using strategic planning and project tracking methods and tools. Conduct regular project progress reviews with internal teams for assigned portfolios, and facilitate conduct of Everest and Client governance meetings to optimize partnership expectations and performance.
* Check and ensure that responsible projects carried out at Everest are properly tracked and managed according to Everest’s quality, operational and financial budget standards. Support solution and budget development for complex and unique projects and scope to address client requirements.
* Provide leadership, training, mentorship, and management oversight of project management staff. This may include mentorship and training of team members to deliver project management services for specific client portfolios, or mentorship and career development of individuals in a line management capacity.
* In consultation with the senior Project Management leadership, review new Project Management Applicants and recommend hires for interview processing.
* In consultation with the senior Project Management leadership, further develop and establish policies and Standard Operating Procedures in project management for assurance of quality deliverables. Continue to support the development, update, and review of governing documents and WIs for the department.
* Initiate, drive, and support project management departmental process and technology improvement initiatives. Lead and contribute to developing reusable project management templates and training materials that can be used to improve effectiveness and efficiency of project delivery by other team members.
* Through the periodic project/portfolio review meetings, effectively identify issues such as lack of planning, lack of resources, poor team performance, or other external factors negatively impacting the ongoing projects, and bring the issues and solutions to the attention of the functional area directors and managers. Work with the functional area directors and managers to jointly ensure smooth project starting up, continuation, and successful completion.
* In consultation with Everest functional leaders and senior project management leadership, interact with clients for strategic partnership governance activities, which includes but is not limited to project pipeline and delivery planning, measuring performance metrics for the portfolio, identifying new project/service opportunities within the existing portfolio, implementing performance improvement and innovation initiatives, and obtaining key information to aid in the projection of resource requirements and project management purposes.
* Manage all project management aspects of assigned Phase I -IV clinical trials and in accordance with ICH guidelines, FDA, Health Canada, EMA, and other applicable regulatory and legal requirements.
* Lead cross-functional project teams. Manage the planning, implementation, conduct, and reporting of assigned projects within the established timelines and budgets, and with the quality and requirements necessary for regulatory approvals.
* Proactively track and manage project tasks against timelines and hours spent/budgets, alert management when there are risks of having major deviations. Proactively track and manage the financial status against budget and reconcile expenses across sub-streams of activities.
* Function as senior level facilitator of problem solving and conflict resolution, and act as a 2nd level escalation resource.
* Conduct “lessons learned” meetings with project team members to learn from failures and prevent same from future projects.
* Contribute and/or participate in the performance evaluation of staff who performed under the responsible projects.
* When required, this position may assist the organization in responding to and preparing for RFI and RFPs, and subsequently leading and participating in bid defense meetings, defining work scopes and budgets, and leading contract administration activities.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in life sciences or health related field.
* A minimum of 18 years of experience in clinical research and development within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, institutional, or CRO setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop others within functional area.
* Demonstrated understanding of cross-functional processes including clinical operations, statistics, data management, pharmacovigilance, subject randomization and drug supply management, data monitoring and adjudication committees, regulatory affairs, and medical writing.
* Knowledge and understanding of ICH guidelines, FDA, Health Canada, and EMA regulations.
* Ability to define scopes and estimate budgets, plan and manage projects, including resource requirements and utilization, hours spent vs. budgets, key deliverables and timelines.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, including setting goals for others and driving to achieve them in accordance with allocated resources, timelines, and budgets.
* Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills. Demonstrated strong negotiation and presentation skills.
* Strong ability in problem-solving, including conflict resolution.

  

**Benefits & Compensation:**

We offer a robust benefits package to support your health, well-being, and growth, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, life & AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability, tuition reimbursement, fitness reimbursement, employee assistance program (EAP), a pension plan, generous paid time off and sick leave, and the opportunity to earn a performance based bonus.

To find out more about Everest Clinical Research and to review other opportunities, please visit our website at www.everestclinical.com (http://www.ecrscorp.com).

* Bachelor's degree required + eight (8) years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with project managers, technical professionals, business leaders, and corporate support functions.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

* Experience supporting the operations of an office, business unit, or portfolio of projects.
* Experience with project financial performance, resource forecasting, utilization management, and operational reporting.
* Experience supporting project managers in improving project execution and resolving performance challenges.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across technical disciplines and business functions.
* Experience implementing or improving operational processes, management controls, and performance reporting.
* Understanding of the commercial and operational drivers of a consulting and professional services business.

The Operations Manager will be a visible and engaged member of the Markham/Mississauga Buildings + Places team, providing practical operational support to project managers and technical leaders while reinforcing accountability for project performance and operational discipline.

The role will focus on identifying emerging issues, coordinating the appropriate people and resources, driving follow-through, and supporting leadership in maintaining consistent operational and project management practices across the business.

Title: Senior Manager, Inside Delivery
Description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

#### **What you'll do**

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

* Creating a strategic roadmap and services architecture for how Scout Motors will sell and transact new and used vehicles to retail customers, from purchase through delivery.
* Supporting and driving the definition and design of the ideal transaction process from an operational perspective (documentation, information flows, and third-party integrations).
* Leading vehicle registration compliance efforts across all active and future sales markets, including program build-out, process design, and cross-functional enablement.
* Developing and documenting comprehensive knowledge of vehicle sales and registration requirements across all states, counties, and localities.
* Designing and operationalizing transaction and delivery workflows and an efficient operating model that ensures a scalable, reliable, customer-centric experience.
* Partnering closely with product managers and engineers to translate operational needs into requirements, prioritize improvements, and develop scalable tools and vendor integrations for end-to-end vehicle sales transactions and deliveries, including documentation, payments, financing, registration, and delivery readiness.
* Leading the operational implementation of AI and automation across the transaction and delivery journey, identifying practical use cases that reduce manual work, improve document accuracy, and help customers complete their purchase and prepare for delivery.
* Owning business testing, rollout, and team adoption of new tools, with clear escalation paths and appropriate human review; measuring impact on transaction completion time, accuracy, team productivity, and the customer experience to guide ongoing improvements.
* Creating a technical support model for sales transaction workflows and operating models.
* Coordinating with Finance to define and build systems that accurately recognize vehicle revenue, ensuring alignment between operations and financial reporting.
* Participating in vendor evaluations and providing operational insight for standard operating procedures, transaction policies, and retail training.

**Location & Travel Expectations**:

* This role will be based out of the **Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC**.
* This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
* Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

#### **What you'll bring**

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 10+ years experience managing automotive sales transactions.
* Deep technical acumen and comprehensive regulatory knowledge, especially in vehicle registration and titling requirements.
* Proven experience in early-stage companies: building teams, policies, tools, and pivoting from design to operational execution.
* Experience implementing AI or automation in operational workflows and working closely with product managers and engineers to deliver scalable tools and measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, with a focus on fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to bring together both internal and external teams behind a common vision; skillful at organizational navigation and cross-functional collaboration at all levels; ability to develop effective partnerships and relationships.
* High agency with capability to independently solve problems and develop strategic, sustainable solutions.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

#### **What you'll gain**

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. Title: VP, Operations & Patient Experience
Description:
**About Us**

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company — it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

**About the Role**

The VP, Operations & Patient Experience leads the teams that deliver care and support to every LifeMD patient. The role oversees about 150 people across clinical support operations (medical assistants, scheduling and clinical program management), the patient care center (customer service, care navigation, sales and quality assurance), and the operations function that keeps the business running (program management, procurement and inventory).

The VP serves as the central hub connecting every part of the business to the patient. Delivering high-quality care depends on ongoing collaboration with marketing, technology, finance, pharmacy and LifeMD's affiliated medical group: aligning patient support capacity with marketing's acquisition and retention plans, shaping the product and technology roadmap around what patients and care teams need, partnering with finance on budgets, KPIs and unit economics, and working with pharmacy and providers so every patient's care, from visit to medication, is seamless.

This is a hands-on operating role for a leader who has run clinical operations at scale. In the coming year, the priorities are using AI and automation to raise productivity across patient support, optimizing every patient touchpoint from onboarding through ongoing care, and lowering the cost of serving each patient.

**Responsibilities**

**Cross-functional Partnership**

* Act as the operational hub between patient-facing teams and the rest of the business, so decisions across every function account for their impact on patient care.
* Partner with marketing on demand forecasts, launches and retention programs, so staffing and support are ready for every patient.
* Partner with technology and product to prioritize platform, workflow and AI improvements based on what patients and care teams need.
* Partner with finance on budgets, operational KPIs and unit economics.
* Partner with LifeMD's pharmacy on fulfillment, shipping and refills, so patients receive their medications reliably and on time.
* Partner with LifeMD's affiliated medical group (PC) on clinical workflows, quality and handoffs between providers and care teams, so care delivery and patient support work as one.

**Clinical Operations**

* Lead clinical support operations, including medical assistants, scheduling and clinical program management.
* Partner with medical group leadership on provider capacity, utilization and coverage across sync and async care.
* Manage clinical vendor relationships, contracts and transitions.

**AI and Automation**

* Lead the adoption of AI and automation across patient support and clinical workflows, including AI agents in the patient care center.
* Measure the impact of each deployment on productivity, quality and cost.

**Cost and Unit Economics**

* Own the operations budget and deliver against annual cost targets.
* Drive down the cost of serving each patient through workforce planning, productivity standards and vendor rationalization.
* Set and report operational KPIs in partnership with finance.

**Patient Care Center and Experience**

* Set the strategy and direction for the patient care center (customer service, care navigation, sales and quality assurance), working through its senior director and director, who lead the teams day to day.
* Own patient experience metrics such as resolution, response times and satisfaction, and partner with the business GMs on the on-therapy patient experience.

**Operations and Program Management**

* Run the program management office for cross-functional initiatives, keeping work on schedule and surfacing bottlenecks early.
* Oversee procurement and inventory.

**Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of directors and senior managers, building a strong leadership bench.
* Represent operations and patient experience with the executive team and with external vendors and partners.

  
**Requirements**  

* 10+ years of operations experience, including 5+ years leading multi-layer operations teams (leaders of managers) with large hourly or clinical support workforces.
* Senior leadership experience in healthcare clinical operations, ideally in virtual care, telehealth or a multi-state provider group.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI or automation in operations, with measurable results.
* Proven cost discipline: has owned a large operating budget and reduced costs without sacrificing quality or patient experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executive and board audiences.

**Preferred**

* A clinical background, such as RN, NP or PA, or a clinical operations leadership track.
* Experience leading a contact center at scale.
* Familiarity with multi-state licensing and the regulatory environment for virtual care.

  
**Benefits**  

* Salary: $200,000-250,000 + 15% bonus
* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, Roth 401k)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Short Term Disability
* Training & Development

Title: Senior Manager, Robot Operations
Description:
**About the Role**
------------------

As **Senior Manager, Robot Operations**, you will lead the day-to-day execution of Dot's autonomous delivery operations in the Phoenix area, ensuring safe, reliable, high-quality, and cost-efficient performance. You will own operational outcomes across fleet availability, productivity, service quality, and unit economics while building the processes and frontline capabilities required to scale commercial operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of commercial execution and robotics R&D. Beyond running daily operations, you will partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to translate field observations, operational data, and recurring robot issues into actionable feedback that improves robot performance and reliability. You will establish a culture of ownership, operational discipline, and continuous improvement—ensuring that commercial operations deliver for customers today while accelerating the development of better robots for tomorrow.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Execute Commercial Operations:** Own daily operations in Phoenix, ensuring consistent execution across robot deployment, dispatch, delivery completion, fleet readiness, and field support.
* **Drive Operational Performance:** Deliver against key metrics for safety, availability, productivity, delivery quality, reliability, customer experience, and cost per delivery.
* **Build Operational Discipline:** Establish and continuously improve SOPs, daily operating rhythms, performance reviews, escalation mechanisms, and frontline accountability.
* **Optimize Fleet Performance:** Monitor robot health, utilization, downtime, intervention rates, and mission success; identify bottlenecks and drive corrective actions.
* **Own Cost and Productivity:** Optimize staffing, fleet utilization, field support, maintenance, and other operating expenses to improve unit economics without compromising safety or quality.
* **Lead Frontline Teams:** Build, coach, and develop a high-performing operations team; establish clear ownership, performance expectations, and a culture of hands-on execution.
* **Support R&D Operations:** Partner with Engineering, Product, Autonomy, Hardware, and Remote Assistance teams to support field testing, software releases, hardware validation, and operational experiments.
* **Build the Engineering Feedback Loop:** Systematically capture field issues, categorize failure modes, quantify operational impact, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions with Engineering and Product.
* **Improve Robot Reliability:** Use operational data and frontline observations to identify recurring failures, reduce human interventions, improve mean time to recovery, and increase successful autonomous mission completion.
* **Manage Operational Readiness:** Ensure robots, people, processes, and infrastructure are ready for new releases, experiments, and changes to commercial operations.
* **Own Incident Response:** Lead operational escalations, coordinate incident resolution, ensure timely communication, and drive lessons learned into preventive actions.
* **Scale What Works:** Develop repeatable operating mechanisms and best practices that can be standardized and replicated across future markets.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* 8+ years of experience in operations leadership across logistics, mobility, robotics, last-mile delivery, fleet operations, or other complex, asset-intensive environments.
* Demonstrated success leading hands-on, day-to-day operations with accountability for service delivery, operational quality, reliability, and cost.
* Experience operating autonomous robots, autonomous vehicles.
* Strong track record of building operational discipline, improving productivity, and delivering measurable performance improvements.
* Experience managing frontline teams, workforce planning, operational processes, and performance management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use operational data to identify trends, diagnose issues, and drive corrective actions.
* Ability to work closely with technical teams to translate field problems into structured engineering feedback and measurable product improvements.
* Demonstrated ownership, urgency, and sound judgment in dynamic environments where priorities can change quickly.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive issues to resolution.
* Willingness to be present in the field, engage directly with frontline teams, and personally troubleshoot operational challenges.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience launching, scaling, or optimizing commercial delivery or fleet operations.
* Familiarity with remote assistance, robot telemetry, fleet management systems, hardware diagnostics, and autonomy-related workflows.
* Experience supporting R&D, field testing, product launches, and engineering validation in live operating environments.
* Experience building structured incident management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement programs.
* Familiarity with SQL, BI dashboards, and data-driven operational performance management.
* Experience improving unit economics through fleet utilization, labor productivity, maintenance optimization, and process standardization.

**Why This Role**
-----------------

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of autonomous delivery by operating at the intersection of **commercial execution and robotics innovation**. You will own the real-world performance of Dot in Phoenix, ensuring that every day of operations delivers better reliability, stronger customer experiences, and improving unit economics.

You will also play a critical role in making our robots better. By connecting field execution with Engineering and Product, you will help transform operational challenges into product improvements and accelerate the path from R&D to scalable commercial deployment.

**We are looking for a hands-on operator who delivers results today, solves problems at their root, and builds the operational foundation for tomorrow's scale.**

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
